 We’re looking for the best people to join us on our journey. Right now, we’re searching for a CS Data Operation Manager in our Stockholm office – are you ready to hit play on an exciting career change?
   

  

**(Note that this is a temporary employment for 1 year)**
 The role
   

  

 As a
 **CS Data Operations Manager** 
 , you will drive data-informed decision making across the Customer Service organization by managing reporting, forecasting, KPI tracking, and financial follow-up. You will transform complex data into clear, actionable insights that support operational performance, strategic planning, and continuous improvement initiatives. You will collaborate closely with stakeholders across Customer Service and the wider business, providing meaningful analysis and recommendations that drive business outcomes.
   

  

 What we’re looking for
   

  

**Role**
 We understand you may feel confident ticking certain boxes more than others and that’s why we always keep an open mind in our recruitment process. But, in order to thrive in this role, we do believe you’ll have at least some experience in the following:
   

  

* You are a curious, analytical, and data-driven person who loves turning numbers into insights and insights into action. You enjoy digging into data, spotting trends, and finding opportunities to improve both performance and ways of working.
* You are comfortable working with reporting, forecasting, KPIs, and financial follow-up, and you can translate complex data into clear and useful insights for different stakeholders. You take ownership of your work, are highly organized, and enjoy improving processes, dashboards, and tools along the way.
* We believe you are a great communicator and a collaborative team player who is also comfortable working independently. Most importantly, you are proactive, solution-oriented, and always looking for ways to make things better.


**It’s a bonus if you have:**
* Experience in Excel and PowerPoint
* A good understanding of data visualization
* Understanding what metrics are relevant and why
* Experience in customer service and working with BPOs
* 5+ years of experience in a data analyst position


 What we offer you
   

  

**We’ve got you covered!** 
 30 days of paid vacation every year, an attractive pension and insurance scheme, and generous parental leave pay lift.
   

  

**Your wellbeing matters.** 
 We provide you with various wellbeing initiatives including wellness allowance.
   

  

**A safe space to grow and up-skill.** 
 Our learning culture puts you in the driver’s seat of your own development.
   

  

**Entertainment is what we love, and entertainment is what we do** 
 . So, unlimited access to Viaplay seems only fair for you to get to know the product – including series & viewing events, new release movie rentals, linear channels and more.
   

  

 Hit play today
   

  

 If this feels like your kind of challenge, make sure you apply by attaching your CV here – you may also want to add your LinkedIn profile. Please don’t send us your application via email because we won’t be able to accept it. We do, however, welcome any questions you may have about this particular position.
   

  

 Want to learn more about who we are and what we do? Check out our careers page or follow us on Instagram! We’re only ever a few clicks away.

title: Masters Thesis Software Engineer Intern
description:
**Description & Requirements**
 Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.
   

  

 Contract: 6-month internship
   

  

 Start Date: Late January 2027
   

  

 Work Model: Hybrid (3 days minimum onsite)
   

  

 The Challenge Ahead
   

  

 Frostbite is EA’s proprietary game engine, powering many of our leading titles across EA SPORTS, Battlefield, and more. We develop shared tools and technologies that connect and empower creators throughout EA. On Frostbite, you’ll collaborate with accomplished teams and contribute to the foundation that enables the creation of immersive, high-quality games for players worldwide.
   

  

 As a Master's Thesis Intern, you will develop a project in an area where Frostbite's engineering efficiency can be multiplied with generative AI, agents, or context engineering. You will also gain an understanding of what it's like to work at EA. An open application means that you can provide ideas for what you want to work on, but we can also explore this together, based on your experiences and interests.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* You will investigate and prototype applying GenAI solutions to Frostbite's development process.
* You will review designs and implementations with other software engineers and will validate your results using a representative dataset.
* You will report to an engineering manager, attend meetings, present progress information and write a final report.


**Eligibility**
* You are pursuing a MsC. in Computer Science (or a related field).
* You are associated with a university education or any other type of education in Sweden that has an internship period planned into the education plan.


**Skills**
* You have experience with Python, C# or C++.
* You understand software development processes.
* You have an interest in applying GenAI to software engineering (e.g. GitHub, CoPilot).
* You have knowledge of AI concepts like knowledge graphs, vector databases, context engineering, MCP servers, LangChain, or RAG.
* You understand software quality, test automation, or CI/CD.


 Help us make play happen. Apply now with an up-to-date CV and Cover Letter in English, explaining what project you would like to work on and explain your pick based on your interests and skills.
   

  

**About Electronic Arts**
 We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.
   

  

 We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.
   

  

 Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

title: Chefsingenjör till enhet för JAS 39 Gripen C/D
description:
Nu söker vi en chefsingenjör som vill vara med och forma framtidens utvecklingsarbete inom JAS 39 Gripen C/D inklusive exportoperatörer. Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta med spännande och varierande uppdrag som sträcker sig över hela livscykeln för JAS 39 Gripen C/D.
   

  

**Om tjänsten**
 I din roll som chefsingenjör för JAS 39 Gripen C/D arbetar du tillsammans med utvecklingsprojektet för att sammanhålla den tekniska verksamheten inom enheten i syfte att uppnå bästa möjliga förmåga, för att skapa hållbara och innovativa lösningar som möter operatörernas behov. Du har fokus på produkten och koordinerar utvecklingsverksamheten såväl inom enheten som med andra utvecklingsprojekt inom Stridsflygavdelningen. Du stöttar vid behov utvecklingsprojektens chefsingenjörer med det tekniska systemarbetet. Du kommer också vara kontaktyta i övergripande tekniska frågor mot leverantörer och kunder inom och utom landet.
   

  

 Tjänsten är placerad i Stockholm alternativt Linköping beroende på var man bor.
   

  

**Om dig**
 Vi söker dig som har civil- eller högskoleingenjörsexamen eller har motsvarande kompetens förvärvad på annat sätt som vi bedömer likvärdig. Du har erfarenhet och kunskap av tekniskt systemarbete (systems engineering). För att lyckas i rollen är det nödvändigt att du har både kunskap och erfarenhet inom flygområdet, specifikt JAS 39 Gripen C/D. Tjänsten ställer krav på att du har goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska både i tal och skrift.
   

  

 Det är meriterande om du har kunskap om certifiering samt regelverket för luftfartsprodukter. Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av flygsystem i livscykelns alla faser samt system- och IT säkerhet. Har du tidigare erfarenhet av Försvarsmaktens verksamhet och dess förmågor inom förbanden, ser vi det som en fördel. För att lyckas i den här rollen ser vi gärna att du har erfarenhet av arbete i ledande befattning.
   

  

 Personliga egenskaper är av stor vikt för oss. Vi välkomnar sökande med olika bakgrund och erfarenheter och söker dig som har god förmåga att arbeta med komplexa system. Du har en hög samarbetsförmåga, lyssnar och kommunicerar på ett konstruktivt sätt. Det är viktigt att du kan planera och strukturera ditt arbete mot mål och resultat samt att du är självgående, flexibel och initiativtagande.
   

  

**FMV – Försvarets materielverk**
 På FMV är du med och bidrar till att göra Sverige och världen säkrare. Vi har i uppdrag att förse det svenska försvaret med den senaste tekniken och kunskapen så att de kan försvara vårt land och våra allierade. Tillsammans med kompetenta och engagerade kollegor får du vara med och utveckla och upphandla det som ibland inte existerar än. Du driver utvecklingen, hela vägen från behov till leverans. Från idé till verklighet.
   

  

**Flyg- och rymd**
 Du kommer att arbeta på vårt verksamhetsområde flyg- och rymdmateriel som ansvarar för de flyg- och rymdsystem som används av Försvarsmakten, exempelvis stridsflyg, helikoptrar och transport- och specialflyg.
   

  

 Hos FMV erbjuds du en trygg anställning med bra förmåner:
   

  

* Kompetensutveckling och karriärmöjligheter
* Flexibel arbetstid och möjlighet till distansarbete i den mån arbetet tillåter
* Tjänstepension och friskvårdsbidrag


 Läs mer om FMV som arbetsgivare och om de förmåner vi erbjuder på vår hemsida: Arbeta på FMV.
   

  

 Vill du vara med och utveckla framtidens försvar? Välkommen med din ansökan senast den 23 oktober 2026.
   

  

**Bra att veta**
* Du ansöker genom att bifoga ditt CV, betyg och intyg på svenska.
* I ditt CV beskriver du tydligt på vilket sätt du uppfyller efterfrågade kvalifikationer och meriter. För att skapa en mer inkluderande rekryteringsprocess ber vi dig att inte skicka personligt brev eller inkludera bild i ditt CV.
* Vi rekryterar kompetensbaserat och bedömer kandidater utifrån rollens krav på erfarenhet, kunskap och personliga egenskaper.
* Våra fackliga företrädare är SACO Mikael Svensson, OFR/S Madeleine Lithander, OFR/O Henry Joona och SEKO Peter Andersson. Alla nås via FMV:s växel: 08-782 4000.
* Vid frågor om tjänsten kan du kontakta rekryterande chef Kristian Säf Pernselius på kristian.saf.pernselius@fmv.se eller via FMV:s växel: 08-782 4000. Kontakta rekryterare Markus Carlén vid frågor om rekryteringsprocessen via e-post: markus.carlen@fmv.se.


 /
   

  

 För att jobba hos oss behöver du vara svensk medborgare och genomgå en säkerhetsprövning i enlighet med säkerhetsskyddslagen. Vi tillämpar provanställning och som anställd kommer du att krigsplaceras utifrån totalförsvarets behov. Ansökningar till befattningen tas endast emot via FMV:s webbplats eller registratur. Vi har gjort vårt medieval och undanber oss därför försäljning av annons- och rekryteringstjänster.

title: Test Fleet Engineer - Trucks
description:
### **Job description**


**About the role**

Would you like to combine technology, coordination and improvement work in a role where teamwork is important? We are now looking for a Test Fleet Engineer to join Sigma and work on an assignment with one of our customers in the automotive industry.


In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring high availability and efficient use of the customer’s test fleet. You will work closely with project management, test teams and workshops, coordinating activities throughout the full vehicle lifecycle. In case of unplanned stops, you will drive the work forward by securing workshop resources, materials, spare parts and transport when needed.


An important part of your daily work will be to drive continuous improvements. You will identify ways to improve working methods and processes and take the initiative to turn ideas into practical changes. Your ability to work with others and get people involved will be important – improvements are something we achieve together.


At Sigma, we offer you a role with a high level of responsibility and the opportunity to make an impact. You will have the stability and team spirit of being part of Sigma while working close to the technology and daily operations in a customer assignment.


**Your profile**

We are looking for someone with broad work experience and experience from several different roles. This has given you a good understanding of how different parts of an organization work together. Experience from the automotive industry, project management or technical coordination is an advantage.


As a person, you are positive, engaged and down-to-earth. You enjoy working with others, building good relationships and getting people involved. You see opportunities rather than problems and have the energy and persistence to drive change forward. Your attitude and ability to create engagement are just as important to us as your technical skills. Simply put, you are someone who puts the team first.


**Experience and qualifications**

* Around 5–10 years of experience working as an engineer, preferably within the automotive industry.
* Good technical understanding and an interest in vehicles and product development.
* Experience coordinating and driving activities from problem to solution.
* Experience with continuous improvement and a natural drive to improve ways of working.
* Good communication skills and fluency in spoken and written English.
* B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Product Development, Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering or a similar field.
  

  

**What can we offer?**  

As an employee with us, you get the opportunity to work across multiple areas with our clients – essentially the best part of being a consultant – but with the security of a single employer! We deliver specialized expertise in areas such as Product Development, UX & Design, PLM, Industrial IT, Production Engineering, and Project Management. Once on assignment, you’ll either be on-site with a client or working on projects from our lovely office, located in the heart of Lindholmen Science Park.


We enjoy doing things together and strive for a good balance between work and leisure. This could include after-work gatherings, events, fitness activities, ski trips, or inspirational talks. We have shared many fun trips together, and in September 2024 we returned from South Africa(!) where we celebrated 10 years as a consulting company!


Professional development has always been important to us. In addition to opportunities for growth through your consulting assignments and various technical trainings, we offer internal programs for personal development.


We also believe that autonomy, involvement, and influence create the motivation needed for you to achieve your personal goals. Our employees choose to work with us because we share this perspective on careers, the future, and life in general. With us, who you are is just as important as what you do. Our goal is to find a structure that gives you the chance to grow and develop into something great together with our clients.


### **More information**

Simon Karlsson,
  

simon.karlsson@sigma.se

title: Lead Engineer Powertrain
description:
### **Job description**


**Do you want to help develop the powertrains of the future for vehicles and industry?**


At Sigma Industry West, we see a growing demand for experienced engineers with expertise in powertrain – and we are now looking for you who want to take part in engineering the powertrains of tomorrow.


With us, you’ll work in project-based assignments, either at the customer’s site or at our in-house operations in Lindholmen, focusing on the development of powertrains, transmissions, and engines (ICE, PHEV, BEV).


As a Powertrain Engineer, you will play a key role in development projects within industrial and marine applications as well as heavy-duty vehicles.


Your work may include design, component responsibility, or, in some cases, technical project management. The projects vary in scope and content – but what they all have in common is close collaboration with our customers, often in an international context. We offer a flexible work environment based at our friendly office in Lindholmen – with a focus on sustainable transport solutions, technical development, and your continued professional growth.


**WE´RE LOOKING FOR YOU WITH**


* B.Sc. / M.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering, Product Development, or similar
* At least 3 years of experience in design or assignment/project management within powertrain
* A strong interest in technology

**MERITS:**


* Experience with heavy-duty vehicles
* LNG & alternative fuels for ICE
* KOLA, KDP
* Experience in designing with CREO, Catia
* Proficiency in Swedish, spoken and written

You are a communicative and collaborative person who quickly adapts to new conditions and customer needs. You thrive in a dynamic environment, are highly driven, and motivated by learning and taking on new challenges. We are looking for someone solution-oriented, committed, and positive, who contributes to a great work atmosphere. Cross-functional collaboration is something you both value and have experience with.


**WHO ARE WE?**


As a consultant at Sigma Industry West, you get the best of both worlds: the variety and development of consulting – with the security of a stable, long-term employer. We provide cutting-edge expertise in areas like Product Development, UX & Design, PLM, Industrial IT, Production Technology, and Project Management. Your assignment may be at the client site or from our vibrant in-house office located in the heart of Lindholmen Science Park.


We believe in doing things together and value a healthy mix of work and fun – from afterworks, events, and workouts to ski trips and inspirational talks. We've taken many exciting trips together and just recently returned from South Africa(!) where we celebrated our 10th anniversary as a consultancy firm.


Competence development has always been a priority for us. In addition to learning in your assignments and various technical trainings, we offer internal programs for personal growth.


We also believe that autonomy, involvement, and influence are key to achieving your personal goals. Our employees have chosen us because we share this view on career, life, and development. To us, who you are is just as important as what you do. Our ambition is to help you grow and evolve into something great – together with our clients.

As part of Sigma Group, we offer the best of both worlds: entrepreneurial spirit and long-term stability.


We’re the smaller company within the larger Sigma network – a group of companies with specialized expertise across different engineering fields. Today, we are over 5,000 employees in 14 countries, making us Sweden’s largest privately owned consulting group.

title: Produktägare
description:
**Vi söker en Produktägare till vårt SaaS-system för hantverksbranschen**

Timeflowsystem utvecklar en modern SaaS-plattform för företag inom bland annat bygg, el, VVS, måleri, mark och andra delar av hantverks- och entreprenadbranschen.

Vi söker nu en erfaren **Produktägare / Product Owner** som vill ta ett operativt ansvar för att leda och driva utvecklingen av plattformen tillsammans med vårt utvecklingsteam.

Rollen

Som Produktägare blir du en central person mellan verksamhet, produkt och utveckling. Du ansvarar för att krav, prioriteringar och funktioner omsätts till tydliga aktiviteter för utvecklingsteamet och följs hela vägen till färdig och kvalitetssäkrad funktion.

Du kommer bland annat att:

* Leda och koordinera utvecklingsteamet
* Planera och prioritera backlog, sprintar och utvecklingsaktiviteter
* Skapa och kvalitetssäkra krav, user stories och Jira-tickets
* Följa upp frontend- och backendutveckling
* Säkerställa att funktioner verkligen är färdigutvecklade innan de stängs
* Delta i dagliga utvecklingsmöten och driva arbetet framåt
* Samarbeta nära med UX/UI, QA och företagsledning
* Identifiera buggar, förbättringar och saknade funktioner
* Säkerställa kvalitet, användarflöden och leverans mot roadmap

Teknisk miljö

Vår plattform utvecklas huvudsakligen med:

**Frontend:** React / Next.js  
**Backend:** Python / Django  
**Projektledning:** Jira  
**Versionshantering:** Bitbucket  
**Design:** Figma

Du behöver inte vara den som programmerar mest i teamet, men du måste ha tillräcklig teknisk förståelse för att kunna diskutera lösningar med utvecklare, förstå arkitektur och API-flöden samt bedöma om en funktion faktiskt är komplett.

Vi söker dig som

* Har tidigare erfarenhet som Product Owner, Technical Product Owner, Project Manager eller motsvarande inom SaaS/systemutveckling
* Har erfarenhet av att leda utvecklingsteam
* Har arbetat med liknande digitala plattformar eller affärssystem
* Förstår både frontend- och backendutveckling
* Har erfarenhet av agilt utvecklingsarbete och Jira
* Är strukturerad, drivande och noggrann
* Kan ställa krav och följa upp utvecklarnas leveranser
* Har stark känsla för kvalitet och användarupplevelse
* Talar och skriver **svenska** obehindrat

Viktigt

Detta är **inte en remote-tjänst**.

Vi söker någon som vill arbeta **heltid och på plats tillsammans med oss** och som vill vara aktivt involverad i den dagliga utvecklingen av produkten.

Vi söker framför allt en person som har erfarenhet från liknande uppdrag och som är van vid att ta ansvar för att ett utvecklingsteam faktiskt levererar kompletta, fungerande och kvalitetssäkrade funktioner.

**Arbetsform:** Heltid, på plats  
**Område:** SaaS / affärssystem / hantverks- och entreprenadbranschen  
**Språk:** Svenska

Är du intresserad av att vara med och bygga nästa generations SaaS-plattform för hantverksbranschen? Då vill vi gärna höra från dig.

* Extra semesterdagar

title: Change Management & Internal Communication Specialist (temporary until spring 2028)
description:
Are you a hands-on communicator who enjoys working where people, technology, and change come together? This role offers the opportunity to support global HR projects, develop clear communication, and help shape accessible digital experiences across Epiroc.  

**It all starts with people. People like you.**  

This is a temporary position until spring 2028.  

**Your mission**
In this role, you will provide support during a period of significant activity across HR communications and digital change. Your mission is to make HR information, tools, and changes easier to understand and use. You will combine hands-on delivery with thoughtful coordination, ensuring that communication is timely, content is reliable, and change management activities remain connected to the needs of employees, managers, and HR colleagues.  

Working with HR process owners, project teams, application owners, and regional stakeholders, you will help keep our SharePoint Epiroc HR Portal useful and current while supporting communication and adoption for active HR projects.  

Responsibilities include:
* Administer the Epiroc HR Portal and associated SharePoint sites, including pages, news, documents, navigation, permissions, publishing requests, and scheduled content reviews.
* Draft, review, publish, and coordinate HR news, emails, announcements, presentations, guides, newsletters, and other communication materials for defined audiences.
* Maintain change management and communication plans for active HR projects, track actions and deadlines, identify affected groups, and support engagement, training, feedback, readiness, and adoption activities.
* Prepare and update practical change materials such as presentations, FAQs, guides, toolkits, stakeholder information, and ADKAR-based assessments or plans.
* Support UX reviews of prioritized HR applications, portals, forms, dashboards, and user journeys for clarity, accessibility, consistency, and ease of use, and provide actionable recommendations.
* Monitor portal and communication analytics, identify engagement or usability trends, and share basic insights with HR stakeholders.
* Coordinate with content owners and project teams, resolve basic SharePoint questions, and escalate technical, strategic, or scope-related matters to the appropriate owner.

  

**Your profile**
You are a collaborative and service-minded communicator who enjoys making complex information clear. You are comfortable working across functions and cultures, following up on details, and balancing several requests without losing sight of the audience. You bring curiosity for digital tools, care about accessible and inclusive experiences, and can move confidently between planning and hands-on delivery.  

Required experience:
* Experience in internal communication, corporate communication, employee communication, employer branding, change management communication, or a related field, preferably in a complex international organization.
* Practical SharePoint experience, or strong digital aptitude and the interest to build SharePoint capability quickly; experience with content publishing, governance, and basic analytics is valued.
* Experience supporting organizational change, stakeholder coordination, communication planning, or user-experience reviews, with the ability to create clear materials in English.
* Experience with UX design of applications, identifying usability issues, unclear terminology, unnecessary complexity and other UX issues
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft Copilot

  

**Location and other**
The primary location is Sweden (Örebro or Stockholm), however, candidates elsewhere in the EMENA region may also be considered.  

**Why Epiroc?**
By joining Epiroc, you’ll make a big difference in the energy transition. At Epiroc, we take pride in being passionate innovators, driving the change toward a brighter future for both people and the planet. Guided by our values of Collaboration, Commitment, and Innovation, we foster a culture of trust, growth, and lasting impact.  

To support your journey, we offer a competitive Total Rewards Package, including:
* Global career opportunities
* Learning & Development programs
* Benefits package, including variable compensation (bonus)
* Flexible work culture promoting balance and well-being
* Global Parental Leave Policy
* Community involvement

  

**Application and contact information**
We encourage you to submit your application through our online career site as soon as possible, but no later than **October 12, 2026.** Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position may be filled before last application date.  

We are committed to a thorough recruitment process, including interviews, reference checks and assessments. To ensure a safe working environment, we conduct identity checks and drug and alcohol screening. Our process is designed to be fair and inclusive; you can expect transparent communication and a balanced evaluation of your skills and experience.  

For questions about the position, please contact:
Hiring Manager, Malin Hedlund Borjesson, malin.hedlund.borjesson@epiroc.com
Recruitment Specialist, Zuzana Matova, zuzana.kalivodova@epiroc.com  

Please note that due to regulations, we cannot handle applications received through email.  

We have already made our choices regarding advertising channels and consulting providers, and kindly request not to be contacted regarding such inquiries.  

**It all starts with people.** The world needs metals and minerals for the energy transition and our cities and infrastructure must be developed to serve a growing population. To succeed, we need to speed up the shift towards more sustainable mining and construction industries. We at Epiroc accelerate this transformation, together with customers and business partners in more than 150 countries, by developing and providing innovative and safe equipment, digital solutions, and aftermarket support.


All new thinkers are welcome. We are looking for those who want to develop, grow, and dare to think new. In Epiroc we attract, develop, and retain diverse talent valuing authenticity and unique perspectives, driving our spirit of innovation. We foster an inclusive culture where diversity isn't just a goal but a part of our values and way of working. This is how we do business for a sustainable future. Learn more at www.epiroc.com

title: Product Manager & Designer
description:
At Viaplay Group, we entertain millions of people every day through our streaming services, radio networks, and TV channels. We believe in the power of content not just as a way of telling stories and touching lives, but also expanding worlds.


We’re looking for the best people to join us on our journey. Right now, we’re searching for a **Product Manager & Designer** in our **Stockholm** office – are you ready to hit play on an exciting career change?


### **The Role**


You’ll work across two small, multidisciplinary teams to improve our products and create value for our users and business, combining product judgement with hands-on UX design.


AI will be a core part of how the teams build and deliver products. You’ll use it throughout product and design work to explore solutions, create prototypes and turn agreed opportunities into useful, testable releases. Together with the teams, you’ll validate outcomes and share what works with the wider organisation.


The work starts with a lab approach, with focused scope, short feedback loops and room to experiment. As we learn what works, you’ll help shape ongoing product responsibilities and ways of working.


**What your day might look like:**


* Turn agreed opportunities into clear priorities, hypotheses, and scope across two teams
* Create user flows, wireframes, and prototypes together with engineers
* Use AI to explore solutions and move from ideas to testable experiences
* Work with users, feedback, and analytics to evaluate what we build
* Help the teams decide what to improve, continue, or stop
* Resolve dependencies with stakeholders and share learning across the teams

### **What we’re looking for**


You’ve worked in a product organisation and contributed directly to both product decisions and UX design. You can show how you’ve used AI across meaningful parts of that work, explain your own contribution, and demonstrate how you evaluated the results.


**For this role, we’re looking for:**


* **Product experience:** Delivering digital products with cross-functional teams, balancing user needs, business impact and technical considerations and taking responsibility for outcomes after release
* **Hands-on design:** The ability to independently create user flows, wireframes and testable prototypes in Figma or comparable tools, and improve them through research and feedback
* **AI-native product development:** Practical experience using AI beyond drafting text or generating isolated concepts, for example to explore solutions, build interactive prototypes or support delivery
* **Evidence and judgement:** Experience using user insights, analytics, hypotheses and experiments to guide decisions. You can distinguish observed evidence from assumptions and evaluate AI-generated output
* **Working across teams:** The ability to balance parallel priorities, build relationships and give teams the context they need to make progress independently

**It’s a bonus if you have:**


* Experience with subscription products, streaming, or other consumer digital services

### **What's in it for you**


An opportunity to help shape how Viaplay builds products with AI. You’ll combine product management and design, work closely with engineers, and see how your decisions influence both the products we deliver and the way the teams develop.


You’ll join at a stage where there is room to experiment and help establish practices that can benefit the wider organisation.


### **What we offer you**


* **We’ve got you covered!** 30 days of paid vacation every year, an attractive pension and insurance scheme, and generous parental leave pay lift.
* **Your wellbeing matters.** We provide you with various wellbeing initiatives including wellness allowance.
* **Flexibility that works.** We follow a hybrid model with at least three days a week in the office, giving you the best mix of collaboration and focus time.
* **A safe space to grow and up-skill.** Our learning culture puts you in the driver’s seat of your own development.
* **An innovative environment with Hack Days once a year.** This week-long initiative allows you to think outside the box and deliver creative, technical solutions that (more often than not) go on to be implemented, either in our product or our ways of working.
* **Entertainment is what we love, and entertainment is what we do.** So, unlimited access to Viaplay seems only fair for you to get to know the product – including serier & viewing events, new release movie rentals, linear channels and more.

### **Hit play today**


If this feels like your kind of challenge, make sure you apply by attaching your CV here – you may also want to add your LinkedIn profile. Please don’t send us your application via email because we won’t be able to accept it. We do, however, welcome any questions you may have about this particular position.
  

  

Want to learn more about who we are and what we do? Check out our careers page or follow us on Instagram! We’re only ever a few clicks away.

title: Career Site Content & Experience Consultant
description:
### **Your New Role**


We are looking for a Career Site Content & Experience Consultant to join a global Talent Acquisition transformation initiative. In this role, you will help create a world-class career site that attracts, engages and inspires talent across different markets and career stages.


You will take ownership of career site content across key candidate journeys, working closely with Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, Communications, HR stakeholders and external partners. Your responsibilities will include conducting stakeholder interviews, developing and editing website copy, employee stories and visual content, and coordinating content reviews and publishing activities.


You will also work closely with an external career site provider to implement content and functionality within Workday, while supporting testing and quality assurance across desktop and mobile. A key part of the role is to continuously improve candidate journeys and create an engaging, intuitive and seamless digital experience.

### **Company Presentation**


Our client is a leading global home appliance company with a strong international presence and a portfolio of well-known household brands. The company operates across around 120 markets and has approximately 39,000 employees worldwide.


With a long history of innovation, the company focuses on creating better living experiences through products and solutions within areas such as cooking, cleaning and wellbeing. Sustainability, innovation and customer experience are important parts of the company's continued development.

### **Good to Know**

**Scope of employment**: Full-time, 100%  

**Type of contract**: Fixed-term employment as a consultant via JobBusters  

**Working model**: Flexible location; Stockholm or remote  

**Salary**: According to agreement  

**Start date**: 2026-11-02  

**End date**: 2027-03-31  

**Application deadline**: Ongoing selection  

**In your application**: Please ensure that your CV clearly demonstrates how you meet the qualifications required by the client

### **To succeed in this role, you will need:**

* Experience in employer branding, recruitment marketing, career site content or talent attraction.
* Strong copywriting and storytelling skills, with the ability to create clear and engaging candidate-focused content.
* Experience managing digital content projects with multiple stakeholders and external partners.
* Understanding of candidate experience, UX and digital engagement.
* Experience working with websites, CMS platforms, career sites or talent acquisition technologies.
* Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage several workstreams independently.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
* A creative, structured and collaborative approach to your work.

### **What we Offer**

* Secure employment with a collective bargaining agreement, insurance coverage and occupational pension
* Wellness allowance and employee discounts and offers via Benifex (e.g., health, leisure, transport and healthcare)
* Flex pension and access to the Lifeplan pension advisory service
* Additional compensation during parental leave
* Occupational health services
* Long-term assignments and a dedicated Consultant Manager for personal support
* Opportunities to build valuable experience, expand your network and grow your future career

### **We look forward to receiving your application**


We review applications on an ongoing basis. As recruitment processes in the consulting industry can move quickly, the position may be filled before the advertised deadline — so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.


You do not need to submit a cover letter. Instead, please respond to the screening questions included in the application process.

title: UX-designer med bakgrund i systemutveckling till SLUs IT-avdelning
description:
Vill du skapa digitala tjänster som gör forskningsdata begriplig, tillgänglig och användbar? Är du kreativ, nyfiken och lösningsorienterad och har ett intresse för miljöområdet? Då kommer du att trivas hos oss.


**Vem är du?**


Vi söker en UX-designer med frontend-erfarenhet som vill vara med och utveckla digitala lösningar inom SLUs forskning och miljöanalys. Hos oss får du arbeta i skärningspunkten mellan användarbehov, design och teknik, tillsammans med utvecklare och verksamhetsexperter.


**Vilka är vi?**


*Mjukvaruutveckling och förvaltning* är en enhet med ett 20-tal anställda utvecklare och testare. Större delen av enheten jobbar på Campus Ultuna i Uppsala, men vi har också medarbetare i Alnarp och Umeå. Vi jobbar i agila team med stort fokus på våra användare, och delar ofta erfarenheter och kompetens över team-gränserna.


**Vad kommer du att göra hos oss?**


* planera och genomföra användarintervjuer
* analysera behov och omsätta dem i användarflöden, koncept, prototyper och gränssnitt
* utveckla och vidareutveckla design för webbapplikationer och digitala tjänster
* genomföra tillgänglighetsgranskningar enligt gällande lagkrav (WCAG)
* samarbeta med systemutvecklare, förvaltningsledare och verksamhetsexperter
* bidra med frontend-utveckling och kunna omsätta design och prototyper till fungerande gränssnitt
* bidra till gemensamma arbetssätt, designprinciper och komponenter

**Vi söker dig som har**


* eftergymnasial utbildning inom Frontend-utveckling och design.
* erfarenhet av UX-design för webbaserade tjänster och applikationer inom universitet eller forskning.
* erfarenhet av att genomföra användarintervjuer, samt att ta fram rekommendationer till verksamheten
* god erfarenhet av att göra klickbara prototyper i Figma
* flerårig erfarenhet av frontend-utveckling och goda kunskaper i HTML, CSS och JavaScript
* erfarenhet av att självständigt genomföra tillgänglighetsgranskningar av webbapplikationer, gärna på myndighet
* erfarenhet av SEO-arbete och förståelse för hur innehåll, struktur, tillgänglighet och tekniska lösningar påverkar webbplatsers synlighet i sökmotorer
* god förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift

**Det är meriterande om du har**


* erfarenhet av moderna frontend-ramverk, exempelvis React
* erfarenhet av att arbeta med designsystem och komponentbibliotek
* erfarenhet av datavisualisering, kartbaserade tjänster eller gränssnitt med stora och komplexa datamängder
* erfarenhet från tvärfunktionella eller agila utvecklingsteam

**Du som person**


Du har lätt för att samarbeta och kan förklara och motivera designval för personer med olika kompetenser och perspektiv. Du är prestigelös och uppskattar att tillsammans med andra prova dig fram, ta emot återkoppling och förbättra lösningar iterativt. Du är också självgående och kan driva ditt eget arbete från behovsanalys till färdig lösning.

  

**Om oss**


På IT-avdelningen arbetar vi med både grundläggande IT-tjänster och anpassade digitala lösningar. Vi stödjer universitetets verksamhet inom forskning, utbildning och administration, vilket ställer höga krav på såväl stabilitet och säkerhet som flexibilitet och utvecklingsförmåga.


IT-avdelningen är en stor avdelning med bred kompetens och många olika specialistområden. Genom samverkan, utveckling och säkerhet arbetar vi för att leverera en modern IT-miljö som skapar nytta för SLU:s verksamhet.


Vi befinner oss i en period med omfattande teknisk och verksamhetsmässig utveckling. Bland annat moderniserar vi universitetets digitala arbetsplats och nätverksmiljö samtidigt som frågor om informationssäkerhet, lagring, data, molntjänster och digitalisering står högt på agendan.

  


**Placering:**


På Campus Ultuna i Uppsala


**Anställningsform:**


Tillsvidareanställning (SLU tillämpar provanställning)


**Omfattning:**


100%. Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.


**Ansökan:**


 senast den 16 oktober 2026.

Verksamhetens kontaktpersoner
* **SOFIA LYBECK**
* Gruppchef Mjukvaruutveckling och förvaltning
* sofia.lybeck@slu.se
**Sveriges lantbruksuniversitet** (SLU) har en nyckelroll i utvecklingen för hållbart liv, grundad i vetenskap och utbildning. Genom vårt fokus på samspelen mellan människa, djur och ekosystem och ett ansvarsfullt brukande av naturresurserna bidrar vi till en hållbar samhällsutveckling och goda livsvillkor på vår planet. Huvudorter är Alnarp, Umeå och Uppsala, men verksamhet bedrivs också på forskningsstationer, försöksparker och utbildningsorter i hela landet. SLU har drygt 4000 medarbetare, 6000 studenter och forskarstuderande och en omsättning på över 4,5 miljarder kronor. Universitetet satsar på attraktiva miljöer på sina campusområden. Vi arbetar för en jämställd och inkluderande arbetsmiljö där öppna samtal mellan människor med olika erfarenheter lägger grunden för vetenskaplighet, kreativitet och utveckling. Vi välkomnar därför personer med olika bakgrunder och perspektiv att söka den aktuella anställningen.

title: Principal User Researcher
description:
**The role**
------------


Sharkmob is an innovative AAA video game company dedicated to creating engaging multiplayer experiences. Our research lab focuses on understanding what drives players and enhances their enjoyment. We collect insights using traditional research methods, whether through usability testing or playtests, to guide our developers in making data-driven decisions. Our Data, User Research, and Design teams work closely to interpret player behaviours and conduct extended research in collaboration with local universities.


As a Principal User Researcher, you will be the craft expert who leads research efforts, mentor teammates, & support design. You will also align user research activities across the studio, driving player-centric game development.  

  

This is a fixed-term position, with the possibility of extension depending on business needs.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Design & execute studies using experimental design and research methodology.
* Actively share knowledge and maintain key stakeholder relationships via workshops, reports, and presentations
* Develop, promote, and ensure good user research practices.
* Guide game teams in planning user research strategies for the lifecycle of their games.
* Support teams via expert reviews, UX writing, and industry knowledge to guide decision making
* Promote collaboration between Data, UX, Design, and Marketing teams.
* Provide consultative support and guidance to senior stakeholders.
* Mentor and upskill User Researchers in all areas of the craft.

**Requirements**
----------------

* 8+ years of experience in user research
* Experience in mentoring or leading teams.
* Bachelor's degree or higher in experimental/social/cognitive psychology, human-computer interaction, or equivalent industry experience.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Extensive experience with user interviews, surveys, moderating research sessions, and usability tests.
* Passion for video games is beneficial, and experience in game development or the entertainment industry is desirable.
* Strong analytical skills with a background or coursework in descriptive and inferential statistics.

### **Bonus points**

* Experience with shooter or live service games.
* Experience in UX design or UX writing

**Who we are**
--------------


Sharkmob is a Swedish game developer founded in 2017. We create AAA-quality games for PC and console, using the Unreal Engine to power our ambitions of taking multiplayer games to new heights.  

We are currently developing ***Exoborne***, our first original IP. In 2022, we released *Bloodhunt,* a battle royale set in the *Vampire: The Masquerade* universe.  

  

At Sharkmob, we believe great games are created by diverse teams with different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences. We are committed to building an inclusive and collaborative workplace where creativity can thrive. Our culture is built around shared ownership, a passion for creating great games, and, just as importantly, having fun along the way.  

  

We’d love for you to join us on our journey and become part of our crew. To learn more about Sharkmob, our projects, and the perks of being a crew member, visit our **homepage**.
company_description: Sharkmob is a game development studio on an epic journey, and we want you to join us! Come explore new territory in the realm of AAA online gaming.

title: Career Site & Experience Consultant
description:
Kommunikation 2 oktober 2026
**Career Site & Experience Consultant**
=======================================


This is a temporary fulltime 4-month assignment from Nov 2026 with flexible location.


**Build a Talent Magnet.**


Our clients vision is to be the home appliance industry leader in consumer satisfaction by delivering outstanding lifetime experiences with solutions that always get better. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver more enjoyable and sustainable living.


Come, join us as you are. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and more innovative. In our global community of people from 100+ countries, we listen to each other, actively contribute and grow together.


Join us in our exciting quest to build the future home!


**About the role:**
  

The Global Talent Acquisition team is embarking on an exciting transformation journey as we launch our new Workday career site. We are looking for a temporary consultant to help us create a world-class candidate experience that attracts, engages, and converts top talent globally through compelling content and seamless digital experiences.


**What you’ll do:**
  

As our Career Site Content & Experience Consultant, you will play a central role in bringing our employer brand to life through a new global career site. Working closely with Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, Communications, HR stakeholders, and external partners, you will transform ideas into engaging content and intuitive digital experiences that inspire people to join Electrolux Group.


You will shape a career site that speaks human, not corporate, using simple and inspiring storytelling to attract talent at every career stage, from graduates to specialists to leaders.


You combine creativity with structure, strong storytelling with project management, and an excellent understanding of what candidates expect from modern digital experiences. If you are passionate about employer branding, content creation, user experience, and talent attraction, this assignment is for you.


**In detail, you will:**
  

* Own the development of career site content across key candidate journeys and audience segments.

* Conduct stakeholder interviews and research to gather insights, stories, and employer value proposition content.


* Create and edit engaging content including website copy, employee stories, videos, and visual assets.


* Partner with the external career site provider to implement content and functionality within Workday.


* Coordinate content reviews, approvals, and publishing activities across global stakeholders.


* Lead testing and quality assurance activities across desktop and mobile experiences.


* Optimize candidate journeys and user experience to create a seamless, attractive, and conversion-focused career site.


**Who you are / Your qualifications:**
  

* Proven experience creating employer branding, recruitment marketing, career site, or talent attraction content.

* Strong copywriting and storytelling skills with the ability to translate business inputs into candidate-centric messaging.


* Experience managing digital content projects involving multiple stakeholders and external vendors.


* Understanding of candidate experience, user experience (UX), and digital engagement best practices.


* Experience working with websites, CMS platforms, career sites, or talent acquisition technologies.


* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and deadlines independently.


* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. Native speaker is a plus.


**Where you’ll be:**
  

This is a temporary consulting assignment running from November 2026 for 4 months.


Preferred location is our Global Headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden. Alternatively, the role can be performed remotely with virtual collaboration across global stakeholders.


**What you’ll gain from this assignment:**
  

* High visibility within a global transformation program.

* Opportunity to shape the future candidate experience of Electrolux Group.


* Collaboration with senior Talent Acquisition and Employer Branding leaders.


* Exposure to global HR technology and digital transformation initiatives.


* Opportunity to influence a career site that reaches candidates worldwide.


* Flexible and international working environment.


The client is a leading global appliance company that has shaped living for the better for more than 100 years. We reinvent taste, care and wellbeing experiences for millions of people, always striving to be at the forefront of sustainability in society through our solutions and operations. Under our group of leading appliance brands, we sell household products in around 120 markets every year and employed 39,000 people around the world.

title: UX/UI designer, WeTransfer
description:
WeTransfer helps millions of users share ideas and collaborate seamlessly. Now part of Bending Spoons, it plays a key role in a portfolio of outstanding digital businesses united by a shared focus on innovation and operational excellence. By applying through the WeTransfer brand, you’ll be stepping into the wider Bending Spoons team. You may work directly on WeTransfer or contribute to one of our other leading products. Either way, you’ll be part of a high-performing, collaborative environment where you can make a real impact.
   

  

 At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards.
   

  

 To achieve this objective, we execute the following strategy: We acquire a digital business with untapped potential and make it as successful as we can by leveraging our platform—which comprises our expertise, technologies, data, brand, talents, and company culture. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we operate so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other. Then, we invest the proceeds into making our platform more powerful, and into acquiring new businesses. Thus, our strategy sees us combine an investor’s attention to capital allocation with the hands-on approach of an operator.
   

  

 For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate.
   

  

**A few examples of your responsibilities** 
* **Shape high-leverage product experiences.** 
 Design exceptional UI and UX—from early concepts to polished delivery—using the best available tools to explore more directions, move faster, and raise the quality bar. Ensure every experience is intuitive, effective, and delightful.
* **Start with an LLM.** 
 Use AI tools to clarify intent, draft short specs, and surface risks, edge cases, and initial approaches before opening any design tool. Use this work to align quickly with your team and compress the time from ambiguity to direction.
* **Prototype and build with AI.** 
 Use Cursor and Claude Code to turn rough concepts into interactive prototypes and generate production-ready frontend code. You know when to reach for code and when to reach for Figma—and you move fluidly between both to get the best result.
* **Co-create with PMs and engineers from day one.** 
 Define UX requirements early, stay in the build through QA and release, and make engineering-aware design decisions.
* **Validate and measure.** 
 Talk directly with customers, run quick tests, and use what you learn to adjust direction. Track funnels, retention, and adoption to assess design effectiveness and sharpen what ships next.
* **Find the highest-leverage bets from the backlog.** 
 Identify where product improvements can unlock business value, align stakeholders around them, and move fast to deliver.


**What we look for** 
* **Reasoning ability.** 
 Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter.
* **Drive.** 
 You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar.
* **Team spirit.** 
 You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent.
* **Proficiency in English.** 
 You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.


**What we offer** 
* **Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams.** 
 You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.
* **An exceptional opportunity for growth.** 
 We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too.
* **Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount.** 
 Typically, we offer individuals with limited experience an annual salary of £85,797 in London and €66,065 elsewhere in Europe. For a candidate that we assess as possessing considerable relevant experience, the salary on offer tends to be between £112,189 and £250,512 in London, and €107,837 and €188,848 elsewhere in Europe. Compensation varies by location and expected impact, and grows rapidly as you gain experience and translate it into greater contributions. For individuals who demonstrate exceptional capability, we may offer compensation that extends beyond the usual ranges to reflect their higher expected impact. If you're offered a permanent contract, you'll also be able to receive some of your pay in company equity at a discounted price, thus participating in the value creation we achieve together. If relocating to Italy, you may enjoy a 50% tax cut.
* **All. These. Benefits.** 
 Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work.


**Commitment & contract**
 Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time.
   

  

**Location**
 Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland), or fully remote from eligible countries.
   

  

**The selection process**
 In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process.
   

  

 Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject.
   

  

 All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here.
   

  

 We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times.
   

  

 We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form.
   

  

**Before you apply**
 If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again.
   

  

 Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment.
   

  

 To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage.
   

  

 If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

title: Digital Designer
description:
We’re Omoi, a creative agency for deep tech: space, aerospace, AI, robotics, energy, life sciences, and more. We help companies with branding, strategy, design, content, and storytelling. Companies doing hard things that are hard to explain.
 




  






 Since we started just two years ago, we’ve worked with nearly 50 companies in more than 7 countries, grown from 2 people to 12, and helped our clients raise over €650m.
 




  






 We’re looking for a
 
**Digital Designer** 

 to build the digital homes of these companies. A website is often the first place investors, partners, and future hires meet the technology. It has to make sense in seconds and feel considered at every scroll.
 




  






 You’ll own website design end to end: research and information architecture, content narrative at the page and section level, wireframes, detailed design, and interactive prototypes. You’ll dig into what makes a company and its technology work, then turn that into something anyone can grasp.
 




  






 Our sites aren’t checkout flows. They explain things, with polish, finesse, and ease. Good UX is the baseline. We want delightful. You think in motion and interaction, and you use storyboards and prototypes to sell concepts to clients and make the handoff to development seamless.
 




  






 You’ll work alongside brand designers, 3D artists, copywriters, and developers. We’re a small, international, cross-disciplinary team, so you’ll get real ownership and work on a lot of different things.
 




  






 This isn’t a role for the faint-hearted. We’re a startup working for startups, and a successful candidate will be prepared for that. Our clients are racing to build things that haven’t existed before, and we move at their speed. It’s hard work, and rewarding work, alongside some of the most innovative teams in the world.
 




  






 You’ll join people who’ve built brands at Bottega Veneta, Ogilvy & Mather, Gin Lane, Great Works, Laird & Partners, Collins, and more.
 




  






 Our working language is English, and all work happens in our studio in central Stockholm. This role is not remote.
 




  






 You have:
 



* 5+ years designing websites, ideally at a small agency or studio
* Sites you've taken from IA through launch
* Expert Figma skills, including prototyping and interaction design
* A sharp eye for typography, layout, and motion
* A knack for making complex technology feel simple
* Confidence presenting work directly to founders
* Bonus: curiosity and hands-on experience with agentic design and creative coding



  






 Send us your CV, your portfolio with live links, and a line on the interaction you’re proudest of and why. Applications without a portfolio won’t be considered.
 




  






 See our work at omoi.co.

title: Product Manager & Designer
description:
At Viaplay Group, we entertain millions of people every day through our streaming services, radio networks, and TV channels. We believe in the power of content not just as a way of telling stories and touching lives, but also expanding worlds.
   

  

 We’re looking for the best people to join us on our journey. Right now, we’re searching for a
 **Product Manager & Designer** 
 in our
 **Stockholm** 
 office – are you ready to hit play on an exciting career change?
   

  

**The Role**
 You’ll work across two small, multidisciplinary teams to improve our products and create value for our users and business, combining product judgement with hands-on UX design.
   

  

 AI will be a core part of how the teams build and deliver products. You’ll use it throughout product and design work to explore solutions, create prototypes and turn agreed opportunities into useful, testable releases. Together with the teams, you’ll validate outcomes and share what works with the wider organisation.
   

  

 The work starts with a lab approach, with focused scope, short feedback loops and room to experiment. As we learn what works, you’ll help shape ongoing product responsibilities and ways of working.
   

  

**What Your Day Might Look Like**
* Turn agreed opportunities into clear priorities, hypotheses, and scope across two teams
* Create user flows, wireframes, and prototypes together with engineers
* Use AI to explore solutions and move from ideas to testable experiences
* Work with users, feedback, and analytics to evaluate what we build
* Help the teams decide what to improve, continue, or stop
* Resolve dependencies with stakeholders and share learning across the teams


**What We’re Looking For**
 You’ve worked in a product organisation and contributed directly to both product decisions and UX design. You can show how you’ve used AI across meaningful parts of that work, explain your own contribution, and demonstrate how you evaluated the results.
   

  

**For This Role, We’re Looking For**
* Product experience: Delivering digital products with cross-functional teams, balancing user needs, business impact and technical considerations and taking responsibility for outcomes after release
* Hands-on design: The ability to independently create user flows, wireframes and testable prototypes in Figma or comparable tools, and improve them through research and feedback
* AI-native product development: Practical experience using AI beyond drafting text or generating isolated concepts, for example to explore solutions, build interactive prototypes or support delivery
* Evidence and judgement: Experience using user insights, analytics, hypotheses and experiments to guide decisions. You can distinguish observed evidence from assumptions and evaluate AI-generated output
* Working across teams: The ability to balance parallel priorities, build relationships and give teams the context they need to make progress independently


**It’s a bonus if you have:** 
  

  

* Experience with subscription products, streaming, or other consumer digital services


 What's in it for you
   

  

 An opportunity to help shape how Viaplay builds products with AI. You’ll combine product management and design, work closely with engineers, and see how your decisions influence both the products we deliver and the way the teams develop.
   

  

 You’ll join at a stage where there is room to experiment and help establish practices that can benefit the wider organisation.
   

  

 What we offer you
   

  

* We’ve got you covered! 30 days of paid vacation every year, an attractive pension and insurance scheme, and generous parental leave pay lift.
* Your wellbeing matters. We provide you with various wellbeing initiatives including wellness allowance.
* Flexibility that works. We follow a hybrid model with at least three days a week in the office, giving you the best mix of collaboration and focus time.
* A safe space to grow and up-skill. Our learning culture puts you in the driver’s seat of your own development.
* An innovative environment with Hack Days once a year. This week-long initiative allows you to think outside the box and deliver creative, technical solutions that (more often than not) go on to be implemented, either in our product or our ways of working.
* Entertainment is what we love, and entertainment is what we do. So, unlimited access to Viaplay seems only fair for you to get to know the product – including serier & viewing events, new release movie rentals, linear channels and more.


**Hit play today**
 If this feels like your kind of challenge, make sure you apply by attaching your CV here – you may also want to add your LinkedIn profile. Please don’t send us your application via email because we won’t be able to accept it. We do, however, welcome any questions you may have about this particular position.
   

  

 Want to learn more about who we are and what we do? Check out our careers page or follow us on Instagram! We’re only ever a few clicks away.

title: [Design] Product Designer L1/L2 - Accommodation (Bangkok-Based)

 At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
   

  

 Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
   

  

 No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
   

  

**Get to Know Our Team:**
 The Design team is a diverse group of product designers and researchers that help to build Agoda’s products from our home office in Bangkok. There is always an opportunity for growth here. Focus on your craft to improve or expand your skill set, or step into a managerial role and flex your talents by driving team projects. The opportunity is here if you want to join a team that’s small enough to be scrappy and hands on, yet big enough to influence change and product strategy. Be a part of Agoda’s Design team and unlock the world for our global community of hotels and travelers.
   

  

**Role in FE Accommodation Team:**
 The FE Accommodation team designs Agoda’s hotel-booking journey—from search and discovery through shortlisting, comparison, and room selection. Our vision is to help every traveler effortlessly find, compare, and book the right hotel with confidence.
   

  

 As a Product Designer, you’ll shape high-impact experiences across this journey, making complex choices feel simple, clear, and trustworthy. title: Design Engineer, Member Experience
description:
**Mission**
 Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.
   

  

 In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.
   

  

 Role Purpose
   

  

 We are looking for an exceptional Design Engineer to own how Neko looks and feels in code, across every surface a member touches: app, web, wearables, clinic and scan room. You take design from Figma to production, hold the bar for interaction, motion and animation, and build the design system that lets a small team ship fast and consistently, whether the code is written by a person or an agent.
   

  

 This is a role for someone who moves quickly, has strong product taste, and cares about getting the details right, because those details are what make a product feel great. Neko has to feel like the future of healthcare.
   

  

 What You'll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months
   

  

* Ship member-facing experiences end to end across app, web, wearables and clinic screens, with prototypes in code within a day (Member-first, always).
* One cross-platform design system, built with Design and Motion: co-define component contracts, own them in code, and carry our motion language into the product (Chase 10X, not 10%).
* Drive adoption: move existing products onto the system, replace duplicated components, and make it the easiest choice for every engineer and their AI tools (Impact, not activity).
* A design system agents can use as well as people: typed, documented and opinionated enough that generated UI looks like Neko by default (Tech-enabled, human-centered).
* Keep evaluating new models and design tooling and rebuilding our workflow when something better comes along (Optimistic truth seeking).


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Deep front-end experience with TypeScript, React and React Native, and a portfolio of shipped work you are proud of. Taste is the first thing we look at.
* A sharp eye for design, interaction and detail: spacing, motion, typography, accessibility and performance.
* You have built or owned a design system other engineers adopted and raised the craft bar for a team.
* A product mindset and the ability to move quickly from idea to production, across the stack when needed.
* Fluent in Figma, including variables and design token pipelines with multi-platform output. You use AI coding tools every day, and you still check every pixel yourself.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Animation and motion on native mobile: Reanimated, Lottie, Rive or similar.
* Building LLM-powered interfaces or AI-driven products.
* Designing for wearables or for screens that run on physical hardware.
* Healthcare, or another field where calm, trust and clarity are the product.


 Our Stack
   

  

* Frontend: React, React Native, TypeScript, Swift and Kotlin where needed, Next.js, Sanity, Vercel
* Backend: C#, Node, Cosmos DB
* Design: Figma
* Tooling: Azure DevOps, Claude Code
