title: CRM Specialist - Hemfint Group
description:
Hemfint Group består av de framgångsrika e-handelsbolagen
 **Hemfint.se** 
 och
 **Outl1.se** 
 , med en omsättning på cirka 500 miljoner kronor och försäljning på fyra marknader. Som en del av BHG Group, en ledande aktör inom heminredning och möbler, erbjuder vi en snabbrörlig och entreprenöriell arbetsmiljö med stort fokus på tillväxt, försäljning och kundupplevelse.
   

  

 För att ta nästa steg i vår utveckling söker vi nu en CRM Specialist som vill utveckla hur vi kommunicerar med våra kunder och bygger långsiktiga kundrelationer. Du får ett brett och operativt ansvar för vårt CRM-arbete – från kampanjer och e-postutskick till segmentering, marketing automation, analys och personalisering.
   

  

 Målet är att utveckla CRM till en ännu starkare kommersiell kanal som bidrar till ökad kundlojalitet, återköpsfrekvens, kundvärde och försäljning.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Som CRM Specialist arbetar du hands-on genom hela processen – från idé och planering till färdigt utskick, analys och optimering.
   

  

 Du planerar CRM-aktiviteter utifrån vår kommersiella kalender och ansvarar självständigt för att skapa och publicera e-postutskick, inklusive budskap, layout, bildval, produktpresentation och CTA:er.
   

  

 En viktig del av rollen är att bygga och optimera automatiserade kundflöden såsom welcome, abandoned cart, post-purchase, win-back och reaktivering. Du arbetar även med segmentering och personalisering för att skapa relevant kommunikation och öka konverteringen.
   

  

 Genom löpande analys av CRM-performance och A/B-testning identifierar du förbättringsmöjligheter och omsätter insikter till konkreta aktiviteter. Du ansvarar även för god datakvalitet samt korrekt hantering av samtycken och GDPR inom CRM.
   

  

 Du arbetar nära framför allt E-commerce Manager och Content Manager, men även inköp och andra kommersiella funktioner. Vi är en mindre och snabbfotad organisation där vi samarbetar tätt och hjälps åt för att driva affären framåt.
   

  

**Vem är du?**
 Vi söker dig som har cirka fem års, eller mer relevant erfarenhet inom CRM, e-mail marketing, marketing automation eller liknande, från e-handel eller annan B2C-verksamhet.
   

  

 Du är van vid att självständigt planera, skapa, genomföra och följa upp CRM-aktiviteter och har erfarenhet av automatiserade kundflöden, segmentering, personalisering och A/B-testning. Du är analytisk och bekväm med att arbeta med CRM-KPI:er för att identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter och driva försäljning.
   

  

 Utbildning inom CRM, marketing automation eller kundanalys är ett plus.
   

  

 Erfarenhet av Klaviyo, GA4 och Funnel är meriterande, liksom kunskaper inom HTML/CSS för e-post samt arbete med retention, Customer Lifetime Value eller lojalitetsprogram.
   

  

 Eftersom du själv producerar kundkommunikation behöver du ha mycket god svenska i tal och skrift samt god engelska.
   

  

**Som person**
 För att trivas och lyckas i rollen tror vi att du är analytisk, kreativ, nyfiken och strukturerad. Du gillar att förstå vad som ligger bakom siffrorna, testa nya idéer och omsätta insikter till förbättringar.
   

  

 Du är samtidigt samarbetsorienterad och prestigelös och trivs i en miljö med högt tempo, många kontaktytor och flera parallella aktiviteter.
   

  

**En roll som kan växa med dig**
 I takt med att vårt CRM-arbete utvecklas finns möjlighet att få ett större strategiskt och kommersiellt ansvar. På sikt kan det innebära arbete med mer avancerad segmentering och personalisering, Customer Lifetime Value, lojalitetsprogram, fler automatiserade kundresor och AI-baserad kundkommunikation.
   

  

 Målsättningen är att CRM ska bli en ännu starkare motor för retention, kundlojalitet och lönsam tillväxt.
   

  

 Vi sitter i moderna lokaler vid Hötorget i Stockholm och erbjuder bland annat frukost varje morgon, friskvårdsbidrag, möjlighet att arbeta hemifrån en fast dag i veckan, flexibla arbetstider, pensionsförsäkring samt tillgång till gym till ett förmånligt pris.
   

  

 Tjänsten är på heltid och tillsvidare med inledande provanställning.
   

  

 Start i januari eller enligt överenskommelse.
   

  

 Du behöver inte bifoga personligt brev – vi utgår från ditt CV och dina svar på urvalsfrågorna.
   

  

 Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Självgående Låssmedstekniker till Spånga lås ( BIAB gruppen )
description:
**Spånga lås** 
 är ett traditionellt låsbolag med en stark förankring i gediget hantverk. Vår verksamhet bygger på vår långa erfarenhet och traditionella hantverk samtidigt som strävar efter att vara på framkant när det gäller de senaste teknologierna och innovationerna inom lås & säkerhet. Vi erbjuder ett brett utbud av tjänster och produkter så som låsbyten, låsöppningar, passersystem och inbrottslarm.
   

  

 Engagemang för kvalitet och miljö genomsyrar hela företaget och vi sätter höga standarder för arbetet vi utför, och produkterna vi levererar till våra kunder. Dessutom är vi medvetna om miljöaspekterna i vår verksamhet och strävar efter att minimera vår miljöpåverkan. Vi är medlemmar i SLR (Svenska Låssmedsmästares Riksförbund), vilket bekräftar vårt engagemang för branschens professionella standarder och etiska principer. Din närmsta chef kommer att vara Alexander som är arbetsledare i Spånga lås, Spånga lås ingår även i BIAB koncernen.
   

  

 Vi rekryterar nu för att möta den ökande efterfrågan på våra tjänster och för att stärka vårt team med fler kompetenta medarbetare.
   

  

**Som Låssmed kommer du att:**
* Installera, driftsätta och projektera/dokumentera låsanläggningar, dörr- och skjutdörrsautomatiker.
* Arbeta med felavhjälpning och förebyggande service på låsanläggningar, dörr och skjutdörrsautomatiker.
* Genomföra avlämning och handhavande utbildning av levererad låsinstallation.
* Utföra utökningsförsäljning och föreslå förbättringsåtgärder i samband med uppdrag hos kund.


**Önskad profil:**
* Tidigare god erfarenhet av branschen.
* Teknisk gymnasieutbildning inom el eller liknande.
* B-körkort.
* Förmåga att uttrycka dig väl i tal och skrift på svenska.


**Vi söker dig som:**
* Har stark drivkraft och målmedvetenhet att prestera det bästa resultatet, detta säkerställer att du alltid strävar efter högsta kvalitet och effektivitet i ditt arbete.
* Är noggrann och kvalitetsmedveten, vilket minimerar risken för fel och säkerställer att våra kunder får de bästa säkerhetslösningarna.
* Har lätt för att samarbeta och kommunicera med kollegor och kunder, detta främjar en bra arbetsmiljö och stärker relationerna med våra kunder.
* Är strukturerad och van att arbeta självständigt, vilket gör att du kan hantera och slutföra arbetsuppgifter effektivt även under minimal övervakning.


**Meriterande om du:**
* Har erfarenhet och kunskaper om tillgänglighets- och frångänglighetsanpassningar.
* Har erfarenhet av brand och utrymnings anpassningar, SSF200, BBR (Boverkets byggregler), entreprenads juridik, dörr montage, jalusimontage, passagesystem och värdeförvaring.
* Innehar gesäll- eller mästarbrev.


**Övrigt:**
 Start: Omgående
   

  

 Arbetstider: 8-17
   

  

 Placering: Du utgår ifrån Spånga, men du kommer jobba i hela stor Stockholm. Du får ta med bilen hem.
   

  

 Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning med 6 månaders provanställning.
   

  

**Förmåner:**
* Rikskuponger (50% subventioneras).
* Friskvårds bidrag.


*Rekryteringen görs i samarbete med Tillväxt Botkyrka. Urvalet sker löpande och dina svar på ansökningsfrågorna ligger till grund för bedömning av din ansökan. På grund av hur annonsplattformen är uppbyggd kan Tillväxt Botkyrka stå som arbetsgivare, men tjänsten som beskrivs ovan är alltid hos den arbetsgivare som omnämns. Arbetsgivaren får rekryteringsstöd av Tillväxt Botkyrka för att hitta just dig.*

title: Sound Design Intern
description:
**Description & Requirements**
 Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.
   

  

 Contract: 6-month Internship
   

  

 Start Date: Late January 2027
   

  

 Work Model: Hybrid (3 days onsite minimum)
   

  

 The Challenge Ahead
   

  

 Battlefield is a storied franchise renowned for uncompromising combat gameplay and all-out warfare, for over two decades. 100 million players and 5 billion hours played later, Battlefield Studios is defining the future of the first-person shooter with the biggest launch in franchise history with Battlefield 6, and a new era beginning with Battlefield REDSEC.
   

  

 United under the banner of Battlefield Studios, 4 world-class teams across Criterion, DICE, Motive, and Ripple Effect have come together to focus on the future of the franchise, a connected Battlefield universe filled with immersive experiences built on our unique DNA.
   

  

 DICE is a creative studio with offices in Stockholm and Gothenburg. We believe in the power of inclusion and welcome game creators from all backgrounds to collaborate with us as we unlock the potential for the future of Battlefield!
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Working under a Lead Sound Designer, you will work within a small and well defined area of a project's sound design.
* You will create content in line with existing designs and audio direction and implement this into the game using the Frostbite game engine.
* You will refine the content and its supporting logic to ensure it is fit for purpose and improve quality, through playtesting and feedback sessions.
* You will provide and respond to Audio feedback and be an active mixer for your assets, and provide feedback on the title's overall mix.


**Eligibility**
* You must be currently enrolled at university or education provider in Sweden with a planned internship period planned (e.g. LiA)
* You are eligible to work in Stockholm, Sweden, without the need for visa/relocation support.
* You are available to commence a full-time 6 month placement at the end of January 2027. Please check with your school before applying.


**Skills**
* Experience of designing sounds for interactive or linear media.
* Proficient skills with modern studio hardware, editing and designing techniques, and software such as Reaper, ProTools, Sound Forge, Waves, IzoTope RX.
* Desire to develop your game audio production, implementation, and engineering skills.
* Knowledge of audio middleware, e.g. WWISE, FMOD, Unreal, Unity are beneficial but not essential.
* Knowledge of graphical audio programming, e.g. Reaktor, Max-MSP, Pure Data, is beneficial.


 Help us make play happen. Apply now with an up-to-date Portfolio, CV and Cover Letter in English, explaining why you would like to join EA for this internship position.
   

  

**About Electronic Arts**
 We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.
   

  

 We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.
   

  

 Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

title: Digital Commerce Activation Specialist Nespresso Nordic
description:
**Nespresso Nordics | Stockholm**
**Join Nespresso Nordics**
 Do you have experience in eCommerce, digital customer experience and the optimisation of digital customer journeys? Do you thrive in a role where you can combine analysis, collaboration and operational execution while helping to develop the digital customer experience of the future?
   

  

 Then you could be our next Digital Commerce Activation Specialist at Nespresso Nordics located in our Stockholm office.
   

  

**Working at Nespresso**
 Nespresso stands for quality, innovation and sustainability. As part of Nestlé, the world’s largest food and beverage company, we offer a workplace where you can grow, contribute and be yourself every day. We are proud to create products and experiences that make a positive difference for both people and the planet.
   

  

 In this role, you will play an important part in developing and improving our digital customer experiences. You will act as the link between eCommerce, Marketing and our B2C teams, helping to strengthen the customer experience and optimise the user journey. This involves close collaboration with our eCommerce Operations team, marketing functions, and our Retail and Trade channels.
   

  

 You will work with the optimisation of customer journeys across everything from ongoing content to global and local campaigns. We operate in a fast-paced and continuously evolving environment where ownership, initiative and the opportunity to make an impact are highly valued.
   

  

 The role is based in Stockholm, and you will report to the Digital Commerce Activation & Optimisation Manager.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As Digital Commerce Activation Specialist, you will be responsible for coordinating campaign and activations for Nespresso across the Nordic region. You will be the eCommerce team’s main point of contact for global and local activities, working closely with Marketing, Supply Chain, Retail and other functions to ensure a first-class customer experience.
   

  

**However, The Role Is About More Than Campaign Execution.**
 We are looking for someone who wants to understand customer behaviour, identify areas for improvement and use data to optimise the customer journey. You are motivated by discovering new opportunities, turning insights into concrete improvements and contributing to even better user experiences across our digital platforms.
   

  

**Your Main Responsibilities**
* Coordinate activations on web and app.
* Collaborate with our operations team to brief activations, optimise customer journeys, eMerchandising and improvements across our eCommerce platforms.
* Collaborate with Marketing and Supply Chain teams on activations.
* Conduct follow-ups and analyse selected campaigns together with relevant stakeholders.
* Identify and follow up on potential issues across our digital platforms using Google Analytics, Power BI and other tools.

title: Master thesis - Robometer for Autonomous Driving Data Selection
description:
**30 credits - Robometer for Autonomous Driving Data Selection**
**Introduction**
 A Master's thesis is an excellent way to get closer to TRATON Group R&D and build relationships for the future.
   

  

**Background**
 The development of models for autonomous driving rely on large-scale driving datasets. While the availability of data has grown substantially, not all recorded driving data contributes equally to model performance. Large portions of driving logs consist of repetitive or uninformative scenarios, whereas rare, safety-critical, or highly interactive situations often provide significantly greater learning value. Consequently, identifying which data should be prioritized during training has become an important research problem in autonomous driving. Current data selection strategies typically rely on heuristic measures such as scenario rarity, uncertainty estimates, diversity metrics, or manually designed filters. More recently, learned data valuation methods have been proposed to estimate the usefulness of individual training samples based on their contribution to downstream model performance.
   

  

 Robometer [1] is a recently proposed foundation reward model for robotics that learns to assess the quality and progress of robot trajectories from large-scale offline data. Rather than evaluating individual observations, Robometer assigns meaningful scores to trajectories based on learned notions of task completion and execution quality. The model has demonstrated strong generalization across robotic manipulation tasks and has been shown to outperform heuristic reward functions in applications such as reinforcement learning, imitation learning, and data retrieval.
   

  

 Although Robometer has been developed for robotic manipulation, its underlying principle of learning trajectory quality is highly relevant for autonomous driving. Driving datasets naturally consist of trajectories with varying levels of complexity, interaction, and execution quality. A learned trajectory scoring model could therefore provide an informative signal for selecting the most valuable training examples, filtering redundant data, or constructing curricula for training driving foundation models.
   

  

 Zero-shot scoring of an autonomous driving scenario with RoboMeter for the task prompt: Safely traverse the intersection when the traffic light turns green.
   

  

**Objective**
 The goal of this thesis is to investigate whether Robometer can be adapted and deployed as a trajectory quality metric for data selection in autonomous driving.
   

  

 This includes:
   

  

  

* Investigating how Robometer can be applied to autonomous driving trajectories and fine- tuning of the model.
* Developing a data-selection pipeline based on Robometer trajectory scores.
* Comparing Robometer with existing data-selection strategies.
* Evaluate whether Robometer-selected datasets improve downstream autonomous driving mod- els in terms of performance, robustness, and data efficiency.


**The Project Offers**
 The student will work on a research problem combining machine learning, autonomous driving and multimodal models. The student will receive supervision from TRATON and have opportunities to interact with researchers and engineers working on machine learning and autonomous driving.
   

  

**Who are we looking for?**
* We are looking for a Master’s student in computer science, machine learning, robotics, engineering physics, electrical engineering, or a related field.
* A suitable candidate should have:
* strong programming skills, preferably in Python and PyTorch;
* knowledge of machine learning and deep learning;
* an interest in autonomous driving, computer vision, transformers, multimodal models, or explainable AI;
* experience with vision-language models, natural-language processing, model interpretability, or autonomous-driving datasets is beneficial but not required; and
* motivation to combine scientific investigation with practical implementation.


 The planned thesis start is January 2027.

 Estimated time required: 20 weeks, full time (30 credits)

title: Master thesis - Efficient World Representations for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
description:
**30 hp - Efficient World Representations for End-to-End Autonomous Driving**
**Introduction**
 A Master's thesis is an excellent way to get closer to TRATON Group R&D and build relationships for the future. In this thesis, you will contribute to EGoPT, a new industrial research project on World Models for Autonomous Driving.
   

  

**Background**
 Modern autonomous vehicles generate large amounts of sensor data from cameras, lidar, radar, and vehicle-state signals. Processing all this information at full resolution and over long temporal histories can exceed the computational budget available for real-time planning. Compressing it too aggressively, however, may remove information that is important for planning or safety.
   

  

 The VINNOVA-FFI EGoPT project investigates how compact, task-aligned representations of multimodal sensor data can support real-time trajectory planning for autonomous heavy-duty vehicles. Current end-to-end driving methods and evaluation tools are mainly developed for passenger cars, while trucks introduce additional constraints related to vehicle size, articulation, load-dependent dynamics, braking distance, and computational resources.
   

  

 The thesis will primarily use public datasets, open-source models, simulation, and planning benchmarks and emerging truck-focused resources.
   

  

**Objective**
 The thesis will investigate an initial research question within EGoPT. Possible directions include:
   

  

  

* Efficient spatial or temporal representations: compress sensor observations or scene history while preserving information needed for planning.
* Adaptive representations: allocate a limited token or compute budget to the cameras, regions, or information most relevant to the current driving situation.
* Safety-aware compression: evaluate whether compact representations preserve safety-critical information.
* Heavy-duty vehicle generalization and evaluation: adapt learned planners to different vehicle configurations, or evaluate and extend public benchmarks with articulated or configuration-dependent constraints.


**Job Description**
 During the thesis period, you will:
   

  

  

* Review relevant literature and help define a focused research question.
* Set up or reproduce an open-source autonomous-driving model, simulator, or benchmark.
* Implement and evaluate a method, benchmark extension, or experimental framework.
* Analyze relevant trade-offs in planning performance, safety, generalization, latency, memory, or computational cost.
* Document the work, present the results, and write the final thesis report.


 The expected outcome is a reproducible model baseline, evaluation method, or experimental framework that can support future research within EGoPT.
   

  

**Education/program/focus**
 You are pursuing a Master's degree in computer science, machine learning, robotics, engineering physics, electrical engineering, or a related technical field.
   

  

 A suitable candidate should have strong programming skills, preferably in Python and PyTorch; knowledge of machine learning and deep learning; an interest in autonomous driving, computer vision, transformers, representation learning, or simulation; and motivation to combine scientific investigation with practical implementation.

title: Senior Kafka Engineer
description:
**About Justera Group**  

Justera Group AB is a leading Swedish IT consulting firm with great experience specializing in building high-performing technology teams and delivering end-to-end IT solutions. Led by dynamic female executives, Justera Group focuses on helping businesses harness the power of digital technologies to continuously evolve in today’s rapidly changing economy. Justera Group manages the entire talent lifecycle, from hiring to ongoing management, ensuring the right fit for each project on time and within budget. With their strong commitment to quality, collaboration, and client success, Justera Group is a trusted partner for technology innovation across Sweden.  

  

**About the Role:**  

We are looking for a Senior Kafka Engineer to join an integration and platform engineering team responsible for building, operating, and continuously improving critical integration and messaging capabilities used by multiple development teams.


The role focuses on Apache Kafka, HiveMQ, Kubernetes, platform stability, automation, self-service, security, and end-to-end operational ownership. You will be responsible for designing and maintaining highly available messaging platforms, automating operational processes, improving observability, and ensuring reliable and scalable platform performance.


The position is primarily platform-focused rather than application-development focused, although you will collaborate closely with development teams and may contribute to customer projects when required.

 **Key Responsibilities:**

* Design, deploy, operate, and maintain multi-cluster and multi-region **Apache Kafka** environments running on Kubernetes, using **Strimzi Operator** or similar technologies.
* Administer and maintain enterprise **HiveMQ MQTT broker** environments.
* Drive the upgrade lifecycle for Kafka, Strimzi, and HiveMQ, including minor and major version upgrades and security patching.
* Coordinate platform patching activities to mitigate vulnerabilities while maintaining application availability.
* Develop and maintain custom **Kafka Connect Source and Sink connectors** for data integration between legacy systems and cloud environments.
* Define and implement Kafka scaling strategies, node affinity, topology spread constraints, and persistent volume configurations for I/O-intensive workloads.
* Manage Kafka broker partition layouts, topic configurations, compaction, retention, segmentation, and cluster-wide resource allocation.
* Design and implement high-availability and disaster-recovery solutions, including cross-region replication and automated failover.
* Manage and enforce data governance using **Schema Registry**, including Avro, Protobuf, and JSON Schema.
* Design messaging traffic routing through ingress and edge technologies such as **Envoy Gateway** or custom proxies.
* Implement Kafka security controls including ACLs, SASL authentication, RBAC, OAuth/OIDC, and API management integrations.
* Implement and maintain security mechanisms such as **mTLS, SSL/TLS, SASL/SCRAM**, and certificate-based authentication.
* Build and maintain observability solutions using **Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, Fluent Bit**, and/or OpenTelemetry.
* Create dashboards and monitoring solutions for key Kafka and infrastructure KPIs.
* Develop proactive alerting for issues such as Kubernetes node failures, JVM memory degradation, disk capacity thresholds, storage problems, consumer lag, and other cluster anomalies.
* Perform **Root Cause Analysis (RCA)** following platform incidents and implement preventive measures and automated guardrails.
* Provide **Tier 3 support** for complex Kafka and integration issues, including consumer lag, rebalance loops, performance issues, and network bottlenecks.
* Act as a technical subject matter expert for development teams working with **Java and Spring Boot**, advising on Kafka Producer/Consumer configurations, idempotency, acknowledgements, batching, schemas, and performance.
* Ensure platform stability, scalability, performance, reliability, and cost efficiency.
* Build and maintain reusable **GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines** for validating, testing, linting, and deploying infrastructure and Kafka-related configurations.
* Implement event-driven application scaling using technologies such as **KEDA**, based on Kafka lag and throughput metrics.
* Apply Infrastructure as Code principles using **Helm**, Terraform, and related tooling.
* Package and manage reusable Helm resources and OCI artifacts.
* Build developer self-service capabilities allowing teams to safely provision topics, schemas, credentials, and other messaging resources within defined architectural and security guardrails.
* Maintain clear technical documentation, READMEs, and operational procedures.
* Handle platform-level incident, problem, and change management.
* Collaborate closely with Security, Architecture, Infrastructure, and Software Development teams.

 **Requirements:**


Kafka & Platform Engineering

* 4–6 years of experience with Apache Kafka at platform/engineering level.
* Strong experience with Kafka clusters, performance tuning, security, and administration.
* Experience with Strimzi Operator and Kafka on Kubernetes.
* Experience with Kafka Connect API.
* Knowledge of Kafka KRaft architecture.
* Experience with HiveMQ or enterprise MQTT platforms.
* Strong understanding of Kafka availability, replication, partitioning, retention, and scaling.


Development

* 4–6 years of experience with Java and Spring Boot.
* Experience developing or maintaining Kafka integrations and custom connectors.
* Experience with PostgreSQL.


Cloud & Kubernetes

* Strong experience with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
* Solid Kubernetes administration and troubleshooting experience.
* Experience working with Linux, including WSL.
* Experience with Azure and/or other major cloud platforms.


DevOps & Automation

* Strong experience with GitHub Actions and/or Jenkins.
* Experience with ArgoCD and GitOps practices.
* Strong Infrastructure as Code experience using Terraform or equivalent.
* Experience with Helm and OCI-based artifact management.
* Experience with automated deployment and platform lifecycle management.


Observability

* Experience with Prometheus and Grafana.
* Experience with Splunk.
* Knowledge of Fluent Bit and/or OpenTelemetry.
* Experience creating dashboards, alerts, and operational monitoring for production platforms.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with API Management (APIM) platforms.
* Experience across Azure, AWS, and/or Google Cloud.
* Experience with cloud cost optimization and resource efficiency.
* Experience working within large enterprise integration or platform engineering departments.
* Experience with Envoy Gateway or similar edge-routing technologies.
* Experience with KEDA and event-driven autoscaling.
* Experience with OAuth/OIDC-based authentication and API security.

**What We Offer:**

* A dynamic and innovative workplace driving advancements in cutting-edge robotic technologies
* The opportunity to collaborate with talented cross-functional teams on meaningful and impactful projects
* Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package
* A supportive culture that fosters continuous learning, growth, and professional development
* Flexible hybrid working model for an optimal work-life balance
* 25 days of annual leave to recharge and relax
* An annual wellness allowance of 3,500 SEK to support your health and wellbeing

In this role, you will partner closely with both Account Executives and Account Managers to drive new customer acquisition and expansion within existing accounts. Som Product Owner för Cloud Platform ansvarar du för produktvision, roadmap och prioriteringar. Du säkerställer att plattformen utvecklas utifrån användarnas behov och samtidigt möter höga krav på säkerhet, compliance, skalbarhet och operativ robusthet.

* Policies & Guardrails och Policy as Code
* Observability & Logging
* GitHub Enterprise Cloud och moderna DevOps-flöden
* Infrastructure as Code och återanvändbara Terraform-moduler
  

  

Du omsätter utvecklingsteamens och verksamhetens behov till konkreta plattformsförmågor och prioriterar utifrån användarvärde, säkerhet, teknisk hållbarhet och strategisk riktning.

  

  

En viktig del av uppdraget är att driva utvecklingen mot mer self-service, automation och Everything as Code samt skapa standardiserade Golden Paths för utvecklingsteamen. Du koordinerar beroenden mellan olika teknikområden och följer upp plattformens adoption, kvalitet och användarupplevelse.

  

  

Du har inte nödvändigtvis personalansvar, men du leder produktens riktning och skapar förutsättningar för flera engineering-team att arbeta mot samma mål.

  

  

Vår ambition är att utvecklingsteam snabbt och enkelt ska kunna konsumera säkra och standardiserade tjänster i stället för att själva bygga infrastrukturen. **Developers should consume capabilities, not build infrastructure.**

  

  

Framgång i rollen innebär bland annat kortare ledtider för nya cloud environments, ökad användning av Golden Paths, färre manuella moment och en bättre developer experience. Samtidigt vill vi öka graden av automatisering och göra det möjligt att introducera nya cloud capabilities snabbare och säkrare.

  

  

### **Din profil**


Vi tror att du har erfarenhet som Product Owner, Product Manager, Platform Lead eller i en liknande roll inom cloud, platform engineering eller software engineering. Du behöver inte själv bygga Terraform-moduler eller designa nätverkslösningar, men du behöver ha tillräcklig teknisk förståelse för att kunna leda produktdiskussioner, förstå beroenden och göra välgrundade prioriteringar.

  

  

Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av flera av följande områden:

  

  

* Public Cloud, exempelvis AWS, Azure eller motsvarande
* Cloud Landing Zones och cloud governance
* Platform Engineering
* Infrastructure as Code och Terraform
* GitHub Enterprise Cloud och DevOps
* Cloud networking och hybrid connectivity
* IAM och identity federation
* Observability, logging och monitoring
* CI/CD och software delivery
* Policy as Code och automated guardrails
* Kubernetes och containerbaserade plattformar
* Security och compliance i enterprise-miljöer
  

  

Erfarenhet från större, komplexa eller reglerade organisationer är meriterande.

  

  

*Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap*.

Du är också kommunikativ och samarbetsorienterad, med förmåga att skapa gemensam riktning mellan utveckling, security, architecture, operations och business.

  

  

### **Vad du blir en del av**


Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas.

description:
Om jobbet Victory Current söker en senior applikationstestare för ett längre konsultuppdrag hos en internationell aktör inom energi- och elkraftsindustrin. Du anställs av Victory Current och får arbeta med tekniskt avancerade system och projekt i en internationell miljö. Victory Current är ett företag baserat i Västerås som erbjuder tekniska konsulttjänster inom elektroteknik, elkraft och IT. Rollen passar dig som har flera års erfarenhet av system- och applikationstestning och som har god förståelse för SCADA-system, gärna i stora och komplexa industriella miljöer.

Du säkerställer att systemens funktionalitet och prestanda uppfyller definierade krav innan leverans och release. Du kommer att arbeta nära utvecklare, produktägare, projektorganisationer och kunder samt bidra till att utveckla testmetoder och arbetssätt för kontinuerlig kvalitetsförbättring. Arbetet omfattar bland annat: Genomföra testscenarier och systemtester inför release Ta fram, dokumentera och underhålla testscenarier utifrån definierade krav Testa och verifiera funktionalitet i större och komplexa SCADA-system Testa både frontend-applikationer och backend-servrar Genomföra funktionella tester samt prestanda-, säkerhets- och automationstester Verifiera korrigeringar och säkerställa att identifierade fel är åtgärdade Delta i framtagning av teststrategier och testplaner Utvärdera testprocesser och identifiera möjligheter till testautomation Samarbeta med utvecklare, produktägare, projektledare och kunder Bidra till kontinuerliga förbättringar av testprocesser och kvalitet Stödja kollegor och bidra till en stark kvalitetskultur Arbeta med testning i agila utvecklingsmiljöer Vi söker dig som har Högskole- eller civilingenjörsexamen inom datavetenskap, elektroteknik eller motsvarande relevant utbildning Minst 3–5 års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet inom system- eller applikationstestning Dokumenterad erfarenhet av SCADA-system Erfarenhet av att utforma och underhålla systemtestscenarier Erfarenhet av funktionell testning, systemtestning och testmetodik Erfarenhet av prestandatestning, säkerhetstestning och/eller testautomation Erfarenhet av agila arbetssätt, exempelvis Scrum Praktisk erfarenhet av verktyg som Azure DevOps, Jira och Confluence Goda kunskaper i engelska, både i tal och skrift Förmåga att kommunicera tekniskt komplex information på ett tydligt och strukturerat sätt Erfarenhet av Linux Kunskap om nätverksprotokoll Kunskap och praktisk erfarenhet av SCADA är ett krav för tjänsten.
  
  

Det är meriterande om du har ISTQB-certifiering eller motsvarande praktisk erfarenhet inom testområdet. Personliga egenskaper För att lyckas i rollen behöver du vara strukturerad, analytisk och kvalitetsmedveten. Du tar ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter och har förmåga att självständigt planera och genomföra tester. Du är kommunikativ och trivs med att samarbeta med utvecklare, projektorganisationer och andra tekniska specialister.
  
  

Du har också lätt för att sätta dig in i komplexa tekniska system och förklara testresultat och tekniska frågeställningar på ett tydligt sätt. Vi värdesätter att du är: Noggrann och analytisk Lösningsorienterad Självständig och ansvarstagande Kommunikativ och samarbetsinriktad Strukturerad och kvalitetsmedveten Bekväm med att arbeta i komplexa tekniska miljöer Anställning och omfattning Du anställs av Victory Current och arbetar som konsult i uppdraget. Anställningsform: Särskild visstidsanställning Placeringsort: Västerås Omfattning: Heltid, 100 procent Anställningsperiod: 2 november 2026 till och med 29 oktober 2027 Arbetsform: Arbetet utförs på plats i Västerås Inför anställningen behöver slutkandidaten genomgå en bakgrundskontroll och ett drogtest samt underteckna ett sekretessavtal. Intyg för SSG Entré kommer också att krävas.

title: Applikationsspecialist inom Tekniskdrift för Hälso- och sjukvård

### **Din arbetsplats**


IT kundgrupp hälso- och sjukvård är en enhet inom Region-IT som består av cirka 25 medarbetare. Tillsammans stöttar vi hälso- och sjukvården i digitaliseringsarbetet som pågår inom hela regionen. ### **Dina arbetsuppgifter**


Som applikationsspecialist tillhör du Region-ITs kundgrupp för hälso- och sjukvård och jobbar tillsammans med kundansvariga, kundleveransansvariga och utvecklingsledare. Arbetsuppgifterna är huvudsakligen drift och utveckling av plattformen för vårdinformationssystemet Cosmic. Det innebär bland annat arbete på vår serverplattform inom SQL-server, applikationsservrar och integrationer mot såväl interna system som nationella tjänster.

### **Dina kunskaper och kompetenser**


Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av

* databashantering av Microsoft SQL Server
* hantering av Microsoft Windows server
* kodning av SQL script
* användning och kodning av Powershell skript


Du ska ha relevant akademisk examen eller erfarenhet som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig. För att vara framgångsrik i rollen behöver du ha en förändringsbenägen inställning och ett stort teknikintresse. Du följer den tekniska utvecklingen samt är insatt i olika tekniska lösningar som gäller på marknaden.


Som person är du noggrann, flexibel och serviceinriktad. Du ska kunna arbeta såväl självständigt som i grupp. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper och din vilja att lära och uppnå resultat. Du har mycket god förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på svenska och engelska.


Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av

* drift av komplexa system
* drift av RedHat Jboss
* drift av Apache Tomcat
* användning CI/CD system
* användning källkodshanteringssystem
* arbete enligt principer DevOps, agiltarbete, sprintplanering
* Linux


Urval till intervjuer sker löpande under annonseringstiden. Välkommen med din ansökan!


Om Region Värmland Vi är till för att alla som bor här ska må bra och för att vår region ska vara attraktiv och konkurrenskraftig. Vi gör skillnad inom hälso- och sjukvård, tandvård, kollektivtrafik, regional utveckling och kultur och bildning. Vi möter människor i livets största stunder och i alla de där vardagsögonblicken där emellan. Vår vision är livskvalitet i världsklass. Läs mer om hur det är att jobba hos oss och våra förmåner och följ oss på sociala medier. Vill du också jobba för alla i Värmland? Välkommen med din ansökan. Övrigt Från 7 juni 2026 gäller EU:s lönetransparensdirektiv - för ökad öppenhet och rättvisa löner. Information om kollektivavtal finns på SKR:s webbplats, Kollektivavtal -SKR I samband med eventuell anställning kan vi komma att be dig som sökande att lämna ett utdrag ur polisens belastningsregister. Inför anställning inom psykiatrisk vård, vård av funktionshindrade, vård av barn eller ungdomar gör arbetsgivaren en kontroll i polisens misstanke och belastningsregister. Ett utslag i detta register kan komma att påverka din möjlighet till anställning. Har du skyddad identitet och vill göra en ansökan ber vi dig att kontakta Kompetensförsörjningsenhet HR via Regionens växel 010-831 50 00. Då får du hjälp att lämna in din ansökan utan att den hanteras i Varbi. Tänk på att endast ta med information som är relevant för den aktuella befattningen. title: Data Scientist
description:
**Mission:**


We are seeking a skilled and motivated Data Scientist to join our team and contribute to the development, implementation, and optimization of advanced algorithms and models. Your work will support key teams such as Field Operations, R&D, Flights, Simulation, Autopilot by automating workflows and enhancing decision support, mission planning, and situational awareness capabilities.

**Requirements:**

* **Education**: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field. A Ph.D. is a plus.
* **Experience**: 3+ years of experience in data science and machine learning modeling, with a focus
* Experience in mission-critical applications such as field operations, situational awareness, or real-time systems.
* Familiarity with tools and frameworks used in geospatial analytics and drone data processing.
* On time series analysis and ideally predictive modeling.
* Strong background in machine learning, data science, and analytics, with hands-on experience in building and deploying models.
* Proven experience working with multi-modal datasets, such as sensor data as time series, GIS data, text, and unstructured data.
* Solid understanding of data pipelines, model evaluation, and production-level deployment.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design, build, and refine machine learning models and data-driven solutions to address real-world operational challenges.
* Work across the entire data science lifecycle: from problem scoping and prototyping to data annotation, model training, performance evaluation, and production deployment.
* Process and analyze diverse datasets, including but not limited to drone sensor data, geospatial (GIS) data, unstructured text, and other sensor modalities.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering and domain experts, to ensure seamless integration of data science solutions into production environments.
* Drive innovation through experimentation, research, and continuous improvement of existing models and systems.
* **Algorithm Development:** Design, develop and implement state-of-the-art algorithms and models, within the context of language models.
* **Capability Development:** Realize new AI-based capabilities in areas such as decision support, mission planning, workflow automation, production data support and predictive modeling and maintenance.
* **Model Training and Optimization:** Train and optimize models using vast amounts of textual data, ensuring high performance and accuracy.
* **Data Preprocessing:** Perform data preprocessing tasks such as data cleaning, outlier detection, feature scaling, and feature encoding to prepare datasets for training and evaluation.
* **Research & Innovation:** Stay up to date with the latest advancements in machine learning both classical techniques and deep learning and proactively apply cutting-edge methods to enhance existing models and develop innovative solutions.
* **Collaboration**: Work closely with data engineers, software developers, product managers and other stakeholders to understand project requirements and deliver effective solutions.
* **Performance Evaluation:** Evaluate the performance of models using appropriate metrics and techniques and iteratively improve their accuracy and efficiency.
* **Deployment:** Collaborate with engineering teams to deploy models into production environments and ensure their robustness and scalability.
* **Documentation:** Maintain comprehensive documentation of models, algorithms and processes for future reference and reproducibility.
**Technical Skills:**

**Programming & Data Manipulation:**


* Proficient in Python, with hands-on experience using libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, and scikit-learn for data analysis and modeling.
* Strong experience with data preprocessing, including handling of time series, unstructured, and geospatial data.
**Machine Learning & Modeling:**

* Expertise in classical ML techniques (e.g., regression, classification, clustering) using scikit-learn, XGBoost, and other ensemble methods.
* Solid understanding of deep learning architectures for time series analysis, including Transformers, RNNs/LSTMs, and CNNs.
* Experience with model training, evaluation, and fine-tuning in varied computing environments.
**Deep Learning Frameworks:**


* Proficient with frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, and TensorRT for building and optimizing deep learning models.
* Experience working with Hugging Face Transformers for sequence modeling and transfer learning tasks.
**Experimentation & Development Tools:**


* Skilled in interactive experimentation environments such as Jupyter Notebooks.
* Familiarity with ML experiment tracking and versioning tools is a plus (e.g., MLflow, Weights & Biases).
**Geospatial & Sensor Data:**

* Experience working with GIS systems, drone sensor data, and multi-modal datasets.
* Familiarity with geospatial libraries and tools such as GeoPandas, Rasterio, QGIS, or similar is a strong advantage.
**Cloud & Deployment:**

* Experience deploying production-grade models, including containerization and REST API integration.
* Familiar with cloud platforms (especially Google Cloud Platform), including ML services, storage, and serverless deployment.
* **Basic understanding of DevOps practices:** version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, telemetry, monitoring, and model lifecycle management.
* **Analytical Skills:** Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to design innovative solutions to complex problems.
* **AI Ethics and Bias Mitigation:** Experience or awareness of AI ethics, fairness and bias mitigation strategies
* **Communication:** Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Collaboration: Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, cross-functional team environment.
* **Attention to Detail**: High attention to detail and a commitment to ensuring the accuracy and quality of work.
* **Adaptability**: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
**What we have to offer you:**

* An excellent work environment and an opportunity to create a real impact in the world;
* A truly high-tech, state-of-the-art engineering company with flat structure and no politics;
* Working with the very latest technologies in Data & AI, including Edge AI, Swarming - both within our software platforms and within our embedded on-board systems;
* Flexible work arrangements;
* Professional development opportunities;
* Collaborative and inclusive work environment;
* Salary compatible with the level of proven experience.

Employment offers may be contingent upon successful completion of a background check and reference verification, in accordance with applicable laws and company policy.

We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, and gender expression), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

title: Data Scientist | LLM Engineer
description:
**Mission:**


As a Data Scientist specializing in LLM you will be responsible for developing, implementing and optimizing advanced algorithms, models and capabilities that help our teams (e.g. Field Operations) automate their workloads, e.g. in the context of decision support, mission planning and situational awareness. You will work on a variety of projects that involve understanding, processing and generating human language to solve complex problems and create innovative solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in LLMs, machine learning and data science, with a proven track record of successful projects in these domains.

**What will be your responsibilities:**

* **Algorithm Development:** Design, develop and implement state-of-the-art algorithms and models, within the context of language models.
* **Capability Development:** Realize new AI-based capabilities in areas such as decision support, mission planning, workflow automation.
* **Model Training and Optimization**: Train and optimize large language models using vast amounts of textual data, ensuring high performance and accuracy.
* **Data Preprocessing**: Perform data preprocessing tasks such as tokenization, stemming, lemmatization and normalization to prepare datasets for training and evaluation.
* **Research and Innovation:** Stay current with the latest advancements in LLM and Natural Language Processing (NLP) and apply new techniques to improve existing models and develop new solutions.
* **Collaboration:** Work closely with data engineers, software developers, product managers and other stakeholders to understand project requirements and deliver effective solutions.
* **Performance Evaluation:** Evaluate the performance of models using appropriate metrics and techniques and iteratively improve their accuracy and efficiency.
* **Deployment:** Collaborate with engineering teams to deploy models into production environments and ensure their robustness and scalability.
* **Documentation:** Maintain comprehensive documentation of models, algorithms and processes for future reference and reproducibility.
**Profile and requirements:**

* **Education**: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field. A Ph.D. is a plus.
* **Experience:** 3+ years of experience in data science, with a focus on large language models and NLP.
**Technical Skills:**

* **Strong programming skills in Python,** with experience using NLP and LLM libraries such as spaCy, Hugging Face (Transformers, Datasets, PEFT, TRL) and the major model families (e.g. GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, Mistral, Qwen, Gemma) via both API and open weights.
* **Proficiency in deep learning frameworks,** primarily PyTorch (plus Keras/TensorFlow as needed), and familiarity with inference optimisation (quantisation, TensorRT-LLM).
* **Experience with data preprocessing**, curation and tokenisation for LLM workloads, including building and cleaning datasets for fine-tuning and retrieval (chunking, embeddings, deduplication, synthetic data generation).
* **Solid understanding of transformer architectures** and attention, with working knowledge of fine-tuning and alignment techniques (full fine-tuning, LoRA/QLoRA, instruction tuning, RLHF/DPO). Exposure to RNNs and CNNs is a plus rather than a core requirement.
* **Experience training and fine-tuning LLMs** and building RAG and agentic systems, including orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph), vector databases (e.g. Qdrant, Weaviate, pgvector) and tool/function calling.
* **Experience with experimentation and tracking tooling**: Jupyter notebooks plus experiment and prompt tracking (MLflow, Weights & Biases) and LLM evaluation (e.g. Ragas, LangSmith/Langfuse, custom eval harnesses).
* **Familiarity with cloud platforms** (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and their AI services, with a focus on Google Cloud (Vertex AI, model garden, managed endpoints).
* **Experience deploying** self-hosted and open-weight LLMs in production, using serving frameworks such as vLLM, TGI, Ollama or llama.cpp, with awareness of GPU sizing, quantisation formats (GGUF, AWQ, GPTQ) and on-prem or airgapped constraints.
* **Working knowledge of MLOps/LLMOps and DevOps practices:** Git, CI/CD, containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes), plus telemetry, monitoring and observability for model and inference performance.
* A**nalytical Skills:** Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to design innovative solutions to complex problems.
* **AI Ethics and Bias Mitigation:** Experience or awareness of AI ethics, fairness and bias mitigation strategies, in the context of NLP and LLMs.
* **Communication:** Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* **Collaboration:** Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, cross-functional team environment.
* Attention to Detail: High attention to detail and a commitment to ensuring the accuracy and quality of work.
* **Adaptability:** Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
**What we have to offer you:**

* An excellent work environment and an opportunity to create a real impact in the world;
* A truly high-tech, state-of-the-art engineering company with flat structure and no politics;
* Working with the very latest technologies in Data & AI, including Edge AI, Swarming - both within our software platforms and within our embedded on-board systems;

title: Cloud Platform Engineer
description:
*Do you want to build a cloud platform that helps keep medicines safe on their way to patients around the world? At TSS, you will help develop technology used by leading pharmaceutical companies worldwide to monitor temperature-sensitive medicines throughout the supply chain. You will also play a central role as TSS takes the next step from on-prem to Azure.* 




  





**About the role** 




 As a Cloud Platform Engineer, you will be part of TSS's Cloud Platform team, which builds and runs the platform that TSS's applications and connected products rely on. You will design, build and operate the platform, and take an active part in technology decisions and the technical roadmap.
 



 The platform is a product in itself. Your job is to make it easy for the application teams to build, deploy, and run their services in a secure, compliant, and reliable way. TSS operates in a regulated environment (GxP), where traceability and quality are part of everyday work. You will help turn compliance requirements into practical technical controls, without making them heavier than they need to be.
 



  





 You will, among other things:
 


* Take part in migrating TSS's on-prem/private cloud environments to Azure, including the IoT cloud that serves a global fleet of around 8,000 gateways.
* Build and operate the Kubernetes (AKS) platform, including cluster lifecycle, ingress, service mesh, certificates and secrets.
* Develop infrastructure as code with Terraform and Terragrunt, and deployment pipelines with GitHub Actions and GitOps.
* Standardize deployment patterns and create templates and golden paths for the development teams.
* Set up monitoring and observability and take part in operations and incident handling.



  





 You will work closely with the application teams and the IoT team. TSS is a small organization with short decision paths, so you will have real influence and be expected to take your own initiatives.
 



 The role is based at TSS's office in Solna, with a hybrid setup where the team typically works from the office 2 days per week.
 



  





**About you** 




 We are looking for a senior engineer with solid experience in building and running cloud platforms in production. You enjoy working close to developers, you have a pragmatic mindset, and you like driving standardization and automation.
 



  





 We believe you have:
 


* At least 5 years of experience in cloud or platform engineering.
* At least 3 years of experience running containers in production, preferably with Kubernetes.
* Experience designing and building platforms, not just using them.
* Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code using Terraform, and with CI/CD and GitOps pipelines.
* Good knowledge of Linux, networking, and monitoring of cloud services.
* A master's degree in a relevant technical field.
* Fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.



  





 Experience with Azure (AKS, Azure Policy, Container Apps), MySQL, Terragrunt, ArgoCD, service mesh and observability tools such as Grafana, Prometheus or OpenTelemetry is a plus. We also value experience of DevSecOps, supply chain security or incident management, as well as a background in MedTech, pharma or other GxP-regulated environments.
 



  





**Interested?** 




 We review applications continuously, so feel free to apply as soon as possible.
 



 If you have any questions about the role, you are welcome to contact Julia Lagerblad, Talent Acquisition Consultant, at
 
 julia.lagerblad@ants.se
 
 .
 



 Please note that background checks are conducted as part of our recruitment process.

title: Senior GCP Platform Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Senior GCP Platform Engineer to design, build, and evolve cloud platform capabilities in a complex enterprise environment.
 



 You will work hands-on with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Kubernetes, GKE, and Terraform, helping engineering teams build, deploy, and operate secure, scalable, and reliable cloud-based workloads.
 



 The role combines platform engineering, infrastructure automation, cloud security, CI/CD, and developer enablement. You will collaborate with architects, platform engineers, data engineers, and security teams to improve platform capabilities and enable engineering teams to work more efficiently.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Design, build, and improve cloud platform capabilities on GCP.
* Develop and operate GKE/Kubernetes environments and container-based workloads.
* Implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform.
* Build and improve CI/CD and GitOps-based delivery workflows.
* Manage cloud networking, IAM, workload identity, and security configurations.
* Develop reusable platform components and self-service capabilities for engineering teams.
* Improve monitoring, logging, observability, and operational reliability.
* Support engineering teams in onboarding and operating workloads on the platform.
* Contribute to platform architecture, technical standards, and long-term improvements.



**Requirements** 



* Senior-level experience in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, or DevOps.
* Strong, hands-on production experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Proven experience with GKE and Kubernetes.
* Strong experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.
* Experience building cloud platform foundations or landing zones.
* Practical knowledge of IAM, workload identity, networking, and cloud security.
* Experience with CI/CD automation and cloud infrastructure delivery.
* Experience with monitoring, logging, and observability.
* Ability to support multiple engineering teams in an enterprise environment.
* Strong technical ownership, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Professional fluency in English.



**Preferred** 



* GCP data services such as BigQuery, Dataflow, and Pub/Sub.
* Apache Beam, data ingestion, or streaming platforms.
* GitOps, Helm, Backstage, or Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs).
* Python and Bash scripting.
* GCP networking and security services.
* Multi-cloud environments involving GCP, AWS, or Azure.
* Platform engineering in regulated or security-sensitive environments.
* Developer self-service and platform enablement.

 Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig! Om du har några frågor eller funderingar kontakta gärna mig Hubertus Von Fluck som är rekryterande chef för denna roll l hubertus.von.fluck@cgi.com
   

  

 Just nu är många av oss på semester och det kan därför dröja med återkoppling på din ansökan. Vi ber om tålamod och kommer att återkomma så snart som möjligt efter semesterperioden Tack för din förståelse.
   

  

**Ensemble, en tant que propriétaires, mettons notre savoir-faire à l’œuvre.**
