title: Regional Sales Director – Nordics
description:
**Build the Nordics with us** 




 Mind The Hack is a European cybersecurity technology company building the
 **Exposure Decision Platform** 
 .
 



  





 We help organizations move beyond vulnerability volume and technical severity by continuously discovering exposures, validating what attackers can actually exploit, connecting proven risks into attack paths, and helping security teams identify the actions that matter most.
 



  





 Our approach combines ethical-hacker methodologies, security automation, exploit validation, attack path analysis, contextual risk prioritization, and AI-assisted decisioning.
 



  





 Mind The Hack already works with major enterprise organizations across regulated and critical sectors, including
 **national aviation infrastructure, telecommunications, banking, and energy** 
 .
 



  





 We are now expanding into the Nordic region.
 



 And we are looking for the person who will build the market with us.
 



  





**The Opportunity** 




 You will become the first senior commercial presence for Mind The Hack in the Nordics, with responsibility across
 **Sweden, Denmark, Norway, and Finland** 
 .
 



 The role will ideally be based in Sweden, with Stockholm as the preferred location.
 



  





 You will report directly to our VP of Sales and work closely with the CEO, Product, Cybersecurity, and Engineering teams.
 



  





 There is no inherited customer book to manage and no mature regional organization to step into.
 



 Instead, you will have the opportunity to:
 


* establish Mind The Hack across the Nordic cybersecurity market;
* open and win strategic enterprise accounts;
* build direct relationships with leading CISOs and security executives;
* shape our Nordic go-to-market strategy;
* identify and develop the right local and regional partners;
* influence how we position and sell the platform across the region;
* and, as the business grows, help build the commercial organization around you.



  





 You will have significant autonomy and ownership of the region, supported by an established sales leadership and technical organization.
 



  





**Who We Are Looking For** 




 We are looking for someone who already knows the Nordic cybersecurity market.
 



  





 Someone who has spent years building trusted relationships with
 **CISOs, security leaders, CIOs, and senior technology decision-makers** 
 .
 



  





 Someone who understands how enterprise cybersecurity buying works across the region and can create new opportunities through their own credibility, relationships, and market presence.
 



  





 Most importantly, we are looking for someone who has repeatedly converted those relationships into new enterprise business.
 



  





 You may currently be a Senior or Strategic Account Executive, Enterprise Sales Director, Regional Sales Manager, Nordic Sales Director, Country Sales Manager, or hold a similar senior commercial position.
 



 Your current title matters less to us than your network, your track record, and your ability to create business.
 



  





**What You Will Own** 




 You will:
 


* Build Mind The Hack's commercial presence across the Nordics from the ground up.
* Develop and execute a focused enterprise target-account strategy across Sweden, Denmark, Norway, and Finland.
* Generate pipeline through your existing network, direct engagement, strategic outreach, partners, and the wider Nordic cybersecurity ecosystem.
* Build trusted relationships with CISOs, security leaders, CIOs, and executive stakeholders across strategic Nordic organizations.
* Personally originate and win new enterprise customers.
* Own the complete sales cycle from first engagement through discovery, demonstration, technical evaluation, Proof of Concept, procurement, negotiation, and close.
* Lead complex, consultative cybersecurity sales processes involving technical, commercial, procurement, and executive stakeholders.
* Work closely with our VP of Sales on regional strategy, account planning, major opportunities, forecasting, and commercial execution.
* Work directly with our cybersecurity, product, and engineering teams throughout demonstrations and technical evaluations.
* Identify and develop selected relationships with MSSPs, systems integrators, cybersecurity advisors, and other strategic partners that can accelerate market access.
* Represent Mind The Hack within relevant Nordic cybersecurity communities, CISO networks, executive forums, partner ecosystems, and industry events.
* Bring market intelligence directly into the company, including customer needs, competitors, pricing, partnerships, and emerging opportunities.
* Help shape how Mind The Hack goes to market across the Nordics.



  





**What You Bring** 




 You should have:
 


* Significant experience selling cybersecurity software, platforms, or technically complex security solutions into enterprise organizations within the Nordic region.
* An
 **established network among Nordic CISOs, security leaders, and senior technology decision-makers** 
 .
* Particularly strong market relationships in Sweden, combined with experience or established relationships in at least one additional Nordic market.
* A strong record of winning
 **new enterprise logos** 
 .
* Evidence that you have personally originated opportunities rather than simply inherited an existing customer base.
* The ability to build meaningful pipeline independently rather than relying primarily on inbound leads, an established global brand, or an existing local sales organization.
* Experience navigating complex enterprise sales cycles involving technical validation, multiple stakeholders, procurement, legal, and executive sponsorship.
* The credibility to engage equally well with technical security teams and senior executives.
* Strong commercial discipline around qualification, account planning, pipeline management, and forecasting.
* Familiarity with MEDDIC, MEDDPICC, or a comparable enterprise sales methodology.
* An entrepreneurial mindset and comfort operating with significant autonomy across multiple countries.
* Professional fluency in English.
* Swedish or another Nordic language is strongly preferred.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 Your first objective is to establish a repeatable enterprise business for Mind The Hack across the Nordic region.
 



 Success during the first year includes:
 


* creating a strong pipeline of qualified enterprise opportunities;
* establishing meaningful relationships with leading Nordic CISOs and security executives;
* winning the first strategic customers across the region;
* establishing a focused network of strategic local and regional partners;
* building strong initial traction in Sweden while developing opportunities across the broader Nordic market;
* and creating a repeatable commercial motion that supports further investment and growth.



  





 As the region develops and agreed commercial milestones are achieved, the role is expected to evolve into broader leadership responsibility, including helping define and build the regional commercial team.
 



  





**Why This Role Is Different** 




 At an established cybersecurity vendor, you may inherit a territory, a customer base, a partner network, and an existing playbook.
 



  





 Here, you have the opportunity to create them.
 



 You will have the backing of our VP of Sales, direct access to company leadership, and close collaboration with the people building and operating the technology.
 



 You will influence our Nordic market strategy.
 



 You will help determine how Mind The Hack establishes itself across one of Europe's most advanced cybersecurity markets.
 



  





 And if you successfully build the region, you will have the opportunity to grow into the person who leads it.
 



  





**We are not looking for someone to manage an existing Nordic territory.** 




  





**We are looking for the person who can build one.** 




  





 If you know the Nordic cybersecurity market, have trusted relationships within the CISO community, and want your next role to be about building something rather than inheriting it, we would like to hear from you.

title: It-tekniker inom container och infrastruktur Östersund
description:
Placeringsort Flera orterDiarienummer FK 2026/030355
   

  

 Logga in och sök jobbet Öppnas i nytt fönster
   

  

*Varje år fattar Försäkringskassan 21 miljoner beslut som påverkar människors liv och hela samhället. Vi betalar ut cirka 260 miljarder kronor varje år. Det är allas skattepengar vi har hand om. Det är ett stort ansvar. Därför tänker vi nytt och använder den senaste tekniken för att förenkla och förbättra, utveckla och leverera it-tjänsterna för den svenska socialförsäkringen. Välkommen till en av Sveriges största IT-avdelningar.*
 It-tekniker inom container och infrastruktur
   

  

 Inom Digitalt samarbete och kommunikation ansvarar vi för att leverera digitala samverkanstjänster i en intern molnmiljö. Tjänsterna körs på våra OpenShift-kluster, både internt inom Försäkringskassan och till andra samverkande myndigheter. Vi ansvarar för tjänsternas hela livscykel, vilket bland annat innebär utveckling, att automatisera installationer och optimera för en stabil drift.
   

  

**Vi Söker Nu Två Nya Medarbetare**
* En it-tekniker till SAFOS (Samarbetsplattform för offentlig sektor)
* En it-tekniker till applikationsdrift i samverkan med anslutande myndigheter.


 I rollen får du jobba med ny teknik, som open source-lösningar och AI, samt ta ansvar för molntjänster byggda på containerteknik. Vi jobbar tillsammans som ett lag i ett högt tempo enligt agila metoder, där vi hela tiden automatiserar för att få till mer effektiva leveranser. Vi söker dig som är en lagspelare och som drivs av utmaningen att lösa svåra uppgifter. Tillsammans med dina kollegor kan du bryta ner problemen så att det blir ett utvecklande och roligt arbete.
   

  

 Tjänsten innebär att du hanterar sekretessbelagda uppgifter vilket ställer höga krav på rätt hantering. Därför är det viktigt att du som ska arbeta hos oss har högt säkerhetsmedvetande.
   

  

 Det är ett jobb för dig som vill vara med och ta ansvar.
   

  

 Vi söker dig som
   

  

* har högskoleexamen eller erfarenheter och kvalifikationer som kan prövas likvärdiga
* har erfarenhet av RedHat OpenShift eller annan Kubernetesdistribution
* har erfarenhet av serverdrift, teknisk felanalys/åtgärd och ändringshantering av Linux
* har erfarenhet av Git
* agerar på eget initiativ och tar ansvar för att nå goda resultat
* samarbetar effektivt med andra för att nå gemensamma mål
* har god kommunikativ förmåga, i tal och skrift
* har ett systematiskt och noggrant arbetssätt
* kan förstå och analysera komplexa frågor
* har goda kunskaper i svenska, i tal och skrift.


 Det är meriterande om du
   

  

* har erfarenhet av Helm
* har erfarenhet från MariaDB
* har erfarenhet av GitOps
* har erfarenhet av Bash och Python
* har erfarenhet inom Ansible.


 Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.
   

  

 Övrigt
   

  

 Två tjänster, tillsvidare, heltid, med tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Provanställning kan bli aktuellt. Vissa anställningar hos oss innebär deltagande i säkerhetskänslig verksamhet. För att bli anställd i en sådan tjänst krävs godkänd säkerhetsprövning enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585).
   

  

 I enlighet med Försäkringskassans riktlinje för säkerhet genomförs bakgrundskontroller i denna rekrytering.
   

  

 I den här rekryteringen kan arbetspsykologiska test användas som en del i urvalsarbetet. Placeringsorter: Sundsvall eller Östersund.
   

  

 Vill du veta mer om Försäkringskassan som arbetsgivare? Besök fk.se/jobbahososs
   

  

 Kontaktpersoner
   

  

 Chef: Fredrik Rasteby, tel 010-114 60 26 (för frågor om tjänsten). HR-specialist: Linnéa Palmkvist, linnea.palmkvist@forsakringskassan,se, 010-113 10 46 (för frågor om rekryteringsprocessen). Fackliga representanter är för ST Marie Nordenfjäll, Saco-S Ann Wiström, Seko Eliza Grundström. Dessa nås via vår växel 08-786 90 00.
   

  

 Ansökan
   

  

 Välkommen med din ansökan senast den 25 oktober 2026. När du ansöker bifogar du ditt CV. Vi använder inte personligt brev i våra rekryteringar, du får istället besvara ett antal urvalsfrågor som är relevanta för tjänsten. Ladda upp dina examensbevis, betyg och intyg i samband med din ansökan. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande under rekryteringsprocessen.
   

  

 Har du skyddade personuppgifter eller ingen tillgång till bank-id ringer du den HR-specialist som finns namngiven i annonsen så får du hjälp med att skicka in din ansökan.
   

  

 Vi ska i allt vi gör, agera med utgångspunkt i principen om alla människors lika värde, rättssäkerhet och med god service.

title: AI Facilitator
description:
Are you passionate about helping organisations turn AI from a buzzword into practical business value? We are looking for an
 **AI Facilitator** 
 for our client, an AI implementation and advisory company located in central Stockholm, with a particular focus on Microsoft Copilot and the broader Microsoft ecosystem.
 



  





 In this highly client-facing role, you will inspire leaders and employees, deliver practical workshops and training programmes, and help customers transform AI opportunities into concrete initiatives. You will combine facilitation, client dialogue, commercial awareness, and a practical understanding of how AI can improve day-to-day business processes.
 



  





 Do you enjoy making complex subjects accessible, engaging audiences, and building trusted customer relationships? Then this could be the right opportunity for you.
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 




  





 • Deliver engaging AI seminars, inspiration sessions, workshops, and tailored training programmes for client teams and leaders.
 



 • Facilitate customer discussions to identify relevant AI use cases, business needs, process improvements, and adoption opportunities.
 



 • Plan, prepare, deliver, and follow up on AI enablement programmes, including training materials, workshop formats, and participant communication.
 



 • Coordinate several parallel client groups, recurring training sessions, timelines, and stakeholders.
 



 • Advise customers on the practical use of Microsoft Copilot, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, AI agents, and existing information structures.
 



 • Build long-term customer relationships and identify opportunities for follow-on workshops, advanced training, and AI implementation initiatives.
 



  





**Ideal candidate profile** 




  





 • Excellent communication, presentation, and facilitation skills, with the confidence to engage senior leaders, employees, and larger groups - both in English and Swedish.
 



 • Experience in client-facing consulting, training, workshops, change management, project management, or digital-transformation initiatives.
 



 • A solid practical understanding of AI, generative AI, AI agents, machine learning concepts, and relevant business use cases; hands-on AI development experience is not required.
 



 • Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Copilot, SharePoint, permissions, data handling, information sharing, and information-security considerations.
 



 • A structured and proactive way of working, with the ability to manage multiple clients, programmes, groups, and deadlines at the same time.
 



 • A commercially minded, relationship-oriented person who is comfortable identifying client needs and developing the conversation beyond the initial workshop or training session.
 



  





**Conditions** 




  





**Location:** 
 Stockholm, Sweden
 



**Work Model:** 
 Primarily on-site and client-facing. The role includes work from the Stockholm office, workshops and meetings at client locations, with some travel required.
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full-time, permanent employment
 



**Salary:** 
 40 000 -60 000 SEK/month
 



  





**Recruitment steps** 




  





 • Initial call with a KUBO recruiter
 



 • Interview(s) with the client
 



 • Decision and feedback

title: Director/Senior Director, Business Development, Clinical Solutions, EMEA
description:
**Join us on our exciting journey!**
 IQVIA™ is The Human Data Science Company™, focused on using data and science to help healthcare clients find better solutions for their patients. Formed through the merger of IMS Health and Quintiles, IQVIA offers a broad range of solutions that harness advances in healthcare information, technology, analytics and human ingenuity to drive healthcare forward.
   

  

**Director/Senior Director, Business Development – Clinical Solutions, EMEA**
 IQVIA is seeking a high-impact Director of Business Development to lead strategic growth initiatives across Mid-size Pharmaceutical accounts.
   

  

 This role is designed for a seasoned commercial leader with deep clinical development expertise and a consultative approach to client engagement. You will be responsible for shaping long-term partnerships, driving complex solution sales, and positioning IQVIA’s RDS capabilities as a catalyst for innovation and speed in drug development.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Achieve individual annual sales target based on selling to pharmaceutical clients across the offering suite to attain TCV quotas as assigned.
* Maintain in-depth knowledge of all IQVIA services for appropriate cross-sell opportunities.
* Actively prospect and leverage potential new business opportunities within specified potential new and/or existing Customers/Accounts.
* Establish and execute a comprehensive sales plan for each target account.
* Cultivate strong, long-term relationships with key decision-makers within Account and develop deep knowledge of the customer organization.
* Actively network in the industry to establish relationships and to identify potential opportunities.
* Aggressively pursue awareness of competitive activities, positioning and pricing, which includes specific reasons for awards and non-awards.
* Continuously monitor status of leads and opportunities to ensure a pipeline of opportunities is maintained.
* Analyse potential opportunities and develop sales strategies for each customer account.
* Ensure appropriate strategy/solution is proposed to customer. Monitor actions and results against plans.
* Establish brand recognition; communicate with internal Project Managers to assess overall level of customer satisfaction and progress of projects.
* Work with operations and functional managers to identify sales team and prepares and leads the sales presentation. Educate team participants in customer culture, operational needs/methods and sales techniques needed to close the sale.
* Coordinate with contracts and proposals to develop proposal.
* Handle follow-up related to the sale and drive completion of contractual documents.
* Utilize CRM to establish reports and dashboards to analyse business development and sales activities and track progress.
* Maintain high visibility within customer organization.
* Lead/participate in change management initiatives for the sales organization.
* Provide overall support and serves as a mentor for junior sales staff members.


**Requirements**
* 10+ years of business development experience in Clinical Research Organizations, with a focus on large-scale clinical programs
* Proven success in managing and growing strategic accounts within mid-size pharma
* Strong understanding of global clinical development, regulatory pathways, and therapeutic area dynamics
* Executive presence with excellent communication, negotiation, and influencing skills
* Ability to navigate complex sales cycles and drive cross-functional collaboration
* Experience with portfolio-level planning, asset prioritization, and long-range forecasting
* Strong financial acumen and ability to structure deals that balance client value with commercial viability


**Why Join?**
 Those who join us become part of a recognized global leader still willing to challenge the status quo to improve patient care. At IQVIA, you will have access to the most cutting-edge technology, the largest data sets, the best analytics tools and, in our opinion, some of the finest minds in the Healthcare industry.
   

  

 You can drive your career at IQVIA and choose the path that best defines your development and success. With exposure across diverse geographies, capabilities, and vast therapeutic and information and technology areas, you can seek opportunities to change and grow without boundaries.
   

  

 We know that meaningful results require not only the right approach but also
 **the right people** 
 . Regardless of your role, we invite you to reimagine healthcare with us. You will have the opportunity to play an important part in helping our clients drive healthcare forward and ultimately improve human health outcomes.
   

  

 It's an exciting time to join and reimagine what's possible in healthcare.
   

  

**Moving healthcare forward. Together.**
*IQVIA is a strong advocate of diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We believe that a work environment that embraces diversity will give us a competitive advantage in the global marketplace and enhance our success. We believe that an inclusive and respectful workplace culture fosters a sense of belonging among our employees, builds a stronger team, and allows individual employees the opportunity to maximize their personal potential.*
 IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at https://jobs.iqvia.com
   

  

 IQVIA is committed to integrity in our hiring process and maintains a zero tolerance policy for candidate fraud. All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.

title: Principal Architect, Manufacturing Security
description:
**Bring more to life.**
 At Danaher, our work saves lives. And each of us plays a part. Fueled by our culture of continuous improvement, we turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.
   

  

  

  

 Our 60,000+ associates work across the globe at more than 15 unique businesses within life sciences, diagnostics, and biotechnology.
   

  

  

  

 Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference? At Danaher, you can build an incredible career at a leading science and technology company, where we’re committed to hiring and developing from within. You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter.
   

  

 Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.
   

  

 The
 **Principal Architect, Manufacturing Security** 
 is responsible for defining and owning Danaher's enterprise OT security architecture across its global manufacturing, lab, and R&D portfolio. This role sets the technical direction for network segmentation, IT/OT boundary design, DMZ architecture, and secure remote access across 15+ operating companies and 160+ sites worldwide. This position offers a rare opportunity to shape the cybersecurity posture of one of the most complex multi-OpCo industrial environments in the global life sciences and diagnostics industry.
   

  

 This position is part of the Corporate Information Security and will be located as Remote in Europe.
   

  

  

  

**In this role, you will have the opportunity to:**
* Own and evolve the enterprise OT security architecture blueprint for Danaher's global manufacturing portfolio — including network segmentation standards, tiered security zone frameworks (ISA-95/Purdue), IT/OT boundary controls, DMZ patterns, and BMS isolation strategy across 15+ operating companies
* Lead the design and portfolio-wide adoption of secure remote access architecture aligned to the remote access platform — retiring legacy VPN and direct-vendor connections, and extending zero-trust network access to OT OEMs, contractors, and remote support vendors across all operating companies
* Partner with the Manufacturing Security Lead and information security leadership to develop OT cybersecurity policies, architecture governance standards, and control frameworks that translate into OpCo-level implementation plans — ensuring consistency across critical sites and the broader portfolio
* Drive the Architecture Review Board (ARB) process for OT security capabilities including micro-segmentation, Remote Access OT extension, OT monitoring tools, and industrial firewall platforms — validating technical designs before deployment and enforcing architectural standards across the portfolio
* Provide expert OT security advisory to OpCo CIOs, site IT leads, and plant engineers — including architecture consultation for high-risk sites and architectural oversight for the segmentation remediation program
* Provide guidelines and standards to align to good security controls in the enablement of digital manufacturing to



***The essential requirements of the job include:***
* Deep expertise in OT/ICS network architecture including Purdue Model/ISA-95 zone segmentation, industrial DMZ design, firewall policy for OT protocols (Modbus, Profinet, EtherNet/IP, OPC-UA, BACnet), and secure remote access architecture for multi-site manufacturing environments
* Hands-on experience designing and validating network segmentation implementations across complex, multi-site OT environments — including PLCs, DCS, SCADA, BMS, HMI, and historian systems — in life sciences, pharmaceutical, or similarly regulated manufacturing
* Strong command of OT-specific cybersecurity frameworks including IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82, CIS Controls for ICS, and CISA/NSA OT security guidance — with demonstrated experience applying these standards in a federated, multi-OpCo enterprise
* Demonstrated experience with zero-trust network access (ZTNA) and SASE architectures (Zscaler or equivalent) in OT environments, including integration with industrial remote access protocols, vendor management workflows, and identity governance
* 12+ years of experience in OT/ICS security, network architecture, or industrial cybersecurity, with at least 5 years in a principal architect, distinguished engineer, or equivalent senior IC capacity within a complex multi-site manufacturing environment



***It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:***
* Experience operating as a technical authority in a federated enterprise model — advising multiple operating companies with distinct OT environments, independent IT governance structures, and different regulatory environments simultaneously.
* Familiarity with industrial micro-segmentation and OT visibility platforms (Elisity, Claroty, Dragos, Nozomi Networks, Armis) and a track record of presenting complex OT architecture decisions to C-suite and board-level audiences, including CISO updates and risk committee briefings.


**Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements**
* ~10% travel regionally and internationally


**Application**
 We continuously assess candidates and invite them for interviews, so please don’t hesitate to write and send in the application. The recruitment will be completed as soon as a suitable candidate is found.
   

  

 Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.
   

  

 For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

title: Product Manager, Ecosystem Integration
description:
**An Amazing Career Opportunity for an Product Manager, Ecosystem Integration!**
**Location:** 
 Stockholm, Sweden preferred or EU Remote
   

  

**Job ID: 48207**
 We are seeking an Ecosystem Strategy and Portfolio Manager to define and drive the evolution of HID reader platforms to connect, align, and integrate across these environments. This role sits at the intersection of Product Management, Sales, Platform Architecture, and Engineering, with strong exposure to external partners and ecosystem stakeholders.
   

  

 HID’s IDT Reader Business Unit is consolidating multiple legacy portfolios into a unified platform strategy across embedded modules, desktop readers, mobile devices, and associated software and cloud services.
   

  

 As this portfolio evolves, ensuring seamless interoperability across both internal platforms and the broader identity ecosystem is critical.
   

  

 This includes defining and driving how Reader BU platforms are aligned with and integrate seamlessly into adjacent systems such as credentials, controllers, authentication providers, and partner platforms, working closely with other Business Units, and Global Engineering teams to align requirements, architectures, and integration models.
   

  

 The position requires a combination of industry understanding, business planning, technical depth, strategic thinking, and cross-functional influence to federate multiple product lines into a consistent and scalable integration model. It plays a key role in driving platform convergence by ensuring integration, reuse, and ecosystem requirements are built into future platform architectures from the outset. The objective is to ensure HID platforms are easy to integrate, consistent to deploy, and built on shared, scalable foundations.
   

  

**Who are we?**
 HID powers the trusted identities of the world’s people, places, and things, allowing people to transact safely, work productively and travel freely.
   

  

 We are a high-tech software company headquartered in Austin, TX, with over 4,500 worldwide employees. Check us out here: www.hidglobal.com and https://youtu.be/23km5H4K9Eo
   

  

**Identification Technologies (IDT):**
 IDT is creating trusted identities for IoT applications through Smart Components and Enabling Services.
   

  

 HID’s Identification Technologies powers the trusted identities of the world’s people, places and things through smart components and cloud services. We make it possible for people and organizations to transact safely, work productively, and travel freely. Our contactless identification and sensing (RFID, NFC, and BLE) components and solution enabling technologies address the dynamic requirements across multiple industries to wirelessly connect, identify, collect and manage data quickly and accurately across virtually any IoT application.
   

  

**Essential Duties :**
* Define and drive how Reader BU platforms are aligned with and integrate into internal systems and adjacent ecosystems.
* Develop business cases for new platform or integration investments.
* Influence future platform definitions by ensuring integration, interoperability, reuse, and ecosystem requirements are built in from the outset.
* Align product managers, platform architects, and engineering teams around common integration principles, standards, and priorities.
* Work closely with Global Engineering leadership to align on architectural decisions, integration frameworks, and platform priorities.
* Define cross-platform requirements early to prevent fragmentation and ensure consistency across product lines.
* Define and drive shared cross-platform roadmap priorities to ensure reuse, consistency, and convergence across Reader BU platforms.
* Drive reuse of common components, services, and integration frameworks across platforms, reducing duplication and accelerating time to market.
* Work with close colleagues to establish a coherent model for how devices, firmware, SDKs, APIs, and cloud services interact across platforms.
* Ensure a consistent and scalable developer and integration experience across all reader platforms.
* Define how Reader BU platforms integrate with external ecosystems, partners, and enterprise architectures.
* Act as the central point of coordination for cross-product and cross-BU integration topics and dependencies.
* Define monetization strategies for integration capabilities, including APIs, services, and ecosystem participation.
* Contribute to relevant industry standards bodies and alliances to ensure alignment and interoperability of Reader BU platforms.
* Maintain a strong understanding of technology trends, competitive ecosystems, and evolving integration models.
* Gather customer, partner, and field feedback to identify integration gaps and prioritize improvements.
* Manage integration capabilities across their full lifecycle, from concept through delivery and continuous improvement.
* Support go-to-market activities with clear positioning, messaging, and enablement around integration capabilities.


**Essential Qualifications**
* Experience in RFID, identification technologies, or adjacent domains.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical field; equivalent experience considered.
* Strong experience in system integration, APIs, SDKs, or platform-based product environments.
* Familiarity with enterprise architectures, IoT ecosystems, and multi-product platform environments.
* Understanding of device security, credential management, secure elements, and authentication frameworks.
* Knowledge of PKI, key management, or IoT security models is a strong plus.
* Experience working with or contributing to industry standards and ecosystem alliances is preferred.
* Proven ability to influence across global, cross-functional teams without direct authority.
* Comfortable operating at both strategic and detailed technical levels.
* Experience working in agile development environments (SAFe is a plus).


**What we can offer you:**
* Competitive salary and rewards package.
* Competitive benefits and annual leave offering, allowing for work-life balance.
* A vibrant, welcoming & inclusive culture.
* Extensive career development opportunities and resources to maximize your potential.
* To be a part of a global organization that is pioneering the hardware, software and services that allow people to confidently navigate the physical and digital worlds.


**Why apply?**
* Empowerment: You’ll work as part of a global team in a flexible work environment, learning and enhancing your expertise. We welcome an opportunity to meet you and learn about your unique talents, skills, and experiences. You don’t need to check all the boxes. If you have most of the skills and experience, we want you to apply.
* Innovation: You embrace challenges and want to drive change. We are open to ideas, including flexible work arrangements, job sharing or part-time job seekers.
* Integrity: You are results-orientated, reliable, and straightforward and value being treated accordingly. We want all our employees to be themselves, to feel appreciated and accepted.


 HID does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services. We are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.
   

  

 HID is committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce that reflects the global communities we serve. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We evaluate applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. Our goal is to create a workplace that empowers everyone to thrive and be their authentic selves, fostering an environment of mutual respect and inclusivity. If you have a disability and require assistance or accommodation to participate in the application process or to perform essential job functions, please contact accommodations-ext@hidglobal.com.
   

  

 Please be aware that our recruitment process may include the use of AI-powered tools to assist in screening applicant resumes. These tools help us efficiently identify candidates whose qualifications and skills align with the job description. We use AI in a responsible manner and in accordance with applicable data privacy laws and regulations. Importantly, all applicants are reviewed by our Talent Acquisition team. AI is used to support, not replace, human judgment in the evaluation process.
   

  

**We make it easier for people to get where they want to go!**
 On an average day, think of how many times you tap, twist, tag, push or swipe to get access, find information, connect with others or track something. HID technology is behind billions of interactions, in more than 100 countries. We help you create a verified, trusted identity that can get you where you need to go – without having to think about it.
   

  

 When you join our HID team, you’ll also be part of the ASSA ABLOY Group, the global leader in access solutions. You’ll have 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally. As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

title: AI Productivity Lead
description:
Have you helped organizations turn AI ambition into real change and wished you could stay to see it through? At If, you can shape how colleagues across the Nordics use AI, aligning teams around clear priorities and building the tools and ways of working that make adoption responsible, measurable and lasting.
   

  

 We are looking for an AI Productivity Lead to define how If can improve employee productivity, collaboration and digital work through AI, helping colleagues thrive in a rapidly evolving landscape.
   

  

**About The Role**
 In this role, you will drive AI initiatives within If, with a particular focus on Digital Workplace, AI productivity tooling and employee collaboration. You will help define direction and priorities, coordinate delivery and adoption, and advise Digital Workplace leadership on where AI can create measurable business value.
   

  

 You may take Product Owner responsibilities when relevant, but the role is defined by its broader mandate to drive AI priorities and value delivery over time. Your focus will be to enable safe, responsible, and scalable AI adoption across If.
   

  

 You will work closely with the AI Acceleration Tribe and relevant squads, specialists and stakeholders across If. As our operating model evolves, your focus will remain on helping If scale AI productivity capabilities responsibly and effectively.
   

  

 The role offers exposure to senior management, and you will regularly present strategic recommendations, priorities and progress to forums such as IT Management, IT operations Management and the Tribe Business Owner Board.
   

  

 You will be a key driver to the long-term AI strategy for employee productivity and collaboration, align priorities across teams, and support the transition from experimentation to enterprise-scale adoption.
   

  

 Your success will be measured by the value you help create, including clearer priorities, faster adoption, stronger governance and scalable platform capabilities.
   

  

**We offer**
* An including work environment where everyone is welcome
* Career and development opportunities in the biggest insurance company in the Nordics
* Social activities, as well as highly skilled professional environment
* Possibility of hybrid workplace
* Health promoting workplace with e.g., wellness allowance and various sports activities
* Great insurance benefits
* Lunch benefit


**About The Team**
 You will be part of our Digital Workplace organization and work across a broad Nordic and cross-functional environment. In Digital Workplace, you’ll help thousands of colleagues use AI in ways that make everyday work simpler, smarter and more effective.
   

  

 As part of a stable and trusted employer, you’ll join a collaborative team that takes ownership, drives meaningful change, and puts employee experience at the centre of everything we do.
   

  

**Who are you?**
 You are a strategic and pragmatic leader who balances long-term vision with a strong focus on getting things done.
   

  

 You are energized by the opportunities AI creates, while remaining focused on business value, usability, security, governance and practical implementation. You set clear priorities, challenge assumptions and are comfortable saying no, or not yet, when needed to protect focus and maximize value.
   

  

 You thrive in complex, fast-moving environments and create momentum through clarity, credibility and collaboration. You can influence senior stakeholders, specialists and decision-makers without formal authority.
   

  

 You move seamlessly between leadership discussions, product prioritization, technology strategy, vendor management, governance requirements, and hands-on backlog work. You are equally comfortable discussing long-term direction with senior leaders as working with teams to turn ideas into tangible outcomes.
   

  

**You Also Have**
* Experience leading AI, digital or business transformation, whether in management consulting, an in-house strategy or transformation role, product management, or a comparable position.
* A strong understanding of AI opportunities, tools, platforms, and adoption challenges in a large organization.
* The ability to connect technology decisions and platform capabilities to measurable employee and business outcomes.
* Experience coordinating funding, capacity, dependencies, or investment proposals across organizational boundaries.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to explain complex topics and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* A structured and analytical approach, combined with sound judgment and the ability to make decisions in the face of uncertainty.
* A relevant academic degree or equivalent professional experience.
* Fluency in English.


**Additional Facts And The Recruitment Process**
**Application deadline:** 
 Screening and interviewing will start immediately. However, application deadline is 2026-10-31.
   

  

**To apply for the position:** 
 Please attach your CV and answer the questions in the application form.
   

  

**Work location:** 
 Stockholm.
   

  

**Travelling:** 
 Occasional travel between If locations may be required.
   

  

**Start:** 
 As soon as possible or by agreement.
   

  

 For more information, please contact Anders Bergqvist, Head of Digital Workplace, anders.bergqvist@if.se and +46 706 182213.
   

  

*Background checks will be done in accordance with the law in the country of employment.*
 We look forward to your application!

title: Head of IT Service Management
description:
**This is Worldline**
 Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across 5 continents. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are seeking an experienced and hands-on
 **Head of IT Service Management** 
 (ITSM) to lead and continuously improve the Worldline Nordic’s IT Service Management capabilities within a regulated payments and acquiring environment. The CIO office provides a range of internally developed IT Services and from Worldline intra-group and third-party providers, many are classified a critical or important functions having strong regulatory requirements on information security and operational resilience. Our internal DevOps teams are working primarily within the Amazon Web Services public cloud and follows modern agile principles and culture with a strong “-If you build it, you run it!” mindset. This means that our DevOps teams are responsible for the continuous development, release and deployment in addition to 24/7/365 operations of their IT services following the processes, guidelines and support from the ITSM function.
   

  

 As a member of the CIO leadership team, you will lead a team of ITSM professionals and act as a key stakeholder across Technology, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Customers, and external service providers. This include managing the recurring ITSM board for review and reporting of various KPIs to the CIO leadership team and other stakeholders.
   

  

**Day-to-day Responsibilities**
* Lead and develop a team of four ITSM professionals, building accountability, collaboration, customer focus, and continuous improvement.
* Own and continuously improve the ITSM framework, processes, standards, controls, and service performance measures in line with ITIL 4.
* Lead core service operations, including incident, problem, event, request, monitoring, and reporting processes.
* Manage major incidents end to end, coordinating response, escalation, stakeholder communication, recovery, and post-incident reviews.
* Govern service transition practices, including change, release, deployment, validation, testing, and knowledge management.
* Ensure ITSM practices support regulatory and internal requirements, including DORA, PSD2, GDPR, ISO 27001, and PCI DSS.


**Who Are We Looking For**
 We look for big thinkers. People who can drive positive change, step up and show what’s next – people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. In practice this means:
   

  

* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with fluency in written and spoken Swedish and English.
* Hands-on experience with ITIL 4, especially IT Service Operations and Service Transition, and an agile mindset focused on continuous delivery.
* Proven ability to manage incidents end to end
* Strong understanding of service governance, operational risk, controls, and regulatory requirements.
* Experience leading ITSM in a regulated environment, managing service providers, or working in payments, fintech, banking, or financial services is an advantage.
* ITIL 4 certification, knowledge of operational resilience requirements such as DORA, and experience with agile frameworks such as SAFe or Scrum are beneficial.
* Experience with modern ITSM platforms and monitoring tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence, DataDog, PowerBI, AI)


**Perks & Benefits**
 At Worldline you’ll get the chance to be at the heart of the global payments technology industry and shape how the world pays and gets paid. On top of that, you will also:
   

  

* Employee Share Program. We win together as a team, and our long-term incentive plans are designed to give every Worldline a financial stake in the business they are helping to grow.
* 30 days annual leave
* Health benefits up to 3000 SEK
* Benefit Portal with lots of good offers


**Shape the evolution**
 We are on an exciting journey towards the next frontiers of payments technology, and we look for big thinkers, people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. Here you'll work with ambitious colleagues from around the world, take on unique challenges as a team, and make a real impact on the society. With an empowering culture, strong technology and extensive training opportunities, we help you accelerate your career - wherever you decide to go. Join our global team of 18,000 innovators and shape a tomorrow that is yours to own.
   

  

 Learn more about life at Worldline at jobs.worldline.com
   

  

 We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as an individual with a disability, or any applicable legally protected characteristics.

title: Enterprise & Business Architect
description:
**Vill du omsätta affärsstrategi till verklig förändring och bidra till att utveckla Combitech i nära samspel med Saab? Vi söker en Enterprise & Business Architect som förenar verksamhetsarkitektur, enterprise architecture och strategisk transformation. Rollen kan utgå från något av våra kontor i Sverige.**
**Hos oss får du en central roll i arbetet med att utveckla verksamhetsförmågor, målarkitektur och långsiktiga roadmaps. Du arbetar nära verksamhetsledning, CIO/Head of IT, arkitekter, produktägare och relevanta funktioner inom Saabkoncernen. Vi erbjuder en roll med stort påverkansutrymme i en kunskapsintensiv organisation där säkerhet, hållbar utveckling och affärsnytta behöver gå hand i hand.**
**Din roll som Enterprise & Business Architect**
 Som Enterprise & Business Architect kombinerar du verksamhetsarkitektur och enterprise architecture för att skapa kopplingen mellan Combitechs strategi, verksamhetsförmågor, processer, information och IT-landskap. Du omsätter verksamhetens mål till tydliga målbilder, styrande principer och prioriterade förändringsinitiativ som skapar långsiktig affärsnytta.
   

  

 I rollen analyserar du nuläge och framtida behov, identifierar gap, beroenden och möjligheter samt tar fram beslutsunderlag som gör det möjligt för ledning och verksamhet att fatta välgrundade strategiska beslut. Du skapar samsyn mellan affär och IT, faciliterar strategiska dialoger och gör komplexa samband begripliga och handlingsbara för olika intressenter.
   

  

 En viktig del av uppdraget är att balansera Combitechs specifika affärsbehov med Saabkoncernens strategiska riktning, gemensamma plattformar och arkitekturprinciper. Du identifierar när gemensamma lösningar och förmågor kan återanvändas och när lokala behov kräver egna vägval. På så sätt bidrar du till ett sammanhållet, säkert och kostnadseffektivt landskap med förmåga att utvecklas över tid.
   

  

 Du kommer att arbeta med utveckling och förvaltning av verksamhetsförmågor, värdeflöden och verksamhetsmodeller samt skapa målarkitekturer och roadmaps för verksamhet, information, applikationer och teknik. Du stödjer portföljstyrning och prioritering genom att tydliggöra affärsnytta, risk och genomförbarhet, samtidigt som du ger strategisk riktning till arkitekter, projekt, produktteam och andra förändringsinitiativ.
   

  

 Genom ditt arbete bidrar du till att Combitech kan prioritera rätt förändringar, använda resurser klokt och bygga de verksamhets- och IT-förmågor som krävs för ett smartare och mer motståndskraftigt samhälle.
   

  

**Vem är du?**
 Du trivs i gränslandet mellan verksamhet, strategi och IT och har förmågan att växla mellan helhetsperspektiv och konkreta frågeställningar. Du är analytisk, lyhörd och pedagogisk och kan skapa struktur och riktning i komplexa miljöer. Samtidigt bygger du förtroende genom att involvera rätt perspektiv och driva arbetet framåt.
   

  

 Vi söker dig som har relevant akademisk utbildning eller motsvarande kompetens förvärvad på annat sätt. Du har erfarenhet av Enterprise Architecture, Business Architecture, verksamhetsutveckling eller strategisk transformation och har arbetat med att omsätta verksamhetsmål till förmågor, målbilder, roadmaps och styrande principer.
   

  

 Du har god förståelse för processer, informationshantering, applikationslandskap och IT-governance. Du är van att facilitera workshops och kommunicera med såväl ledning som specialister och uttrycker dig väl på svenska och engelska.
   

  

 Det är positivt om du har arbetat med capability-based planning, värdeflöden och målbildsarbete samt har kunskap om ramverk och metoder som TOGAF, ArchiMate, BIZBOK eller motsvarande. Erfarenhet av portföljstyrning, investeringsprioritering, större transformationsinitiativ, informationsarkitektur, data governance, cybersäkerhet eller arkitekturarbete i större organisationer är också värdefullt.
   

  

**Då tjänsten innebär arbete som omfattas av försvarssekretess krävs det att du genomför och godkänns i en säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll.**
**Urval sker löpande. Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!**
**Kom & gör skillnad**
 För oss är våra medarbetare nyckeln till att bygga ett smart och motståndskraftigt samhälle. Vi vet att effekten av dagens teknik enbart kan nå sin fulla potential när det finns rätt människor på rätt plats som nyttjar den. Vi tror på kraften i kollektiv intelligens och erfarenhet - något som uppstår när individer med olika kompetenser och perspektiv möts. Därför prioriterar vi mångfald och inkludering, för vi vet att det är avgörande för att öka kreativitet, innovation, engagemang och välbefinnande.
   

  

**Vill du veta mer om hur det är att arbeta hos oss? Kolla in** 
**våra karriärsidor** 
**.**
**Kontaktperson/rekryterande chef: Tomas Lundberg, tomas.lundberg (@) combitech.com**
**Vi undanber oss rekryteringssamarbeten.**

title: Information Security Officer
description:
*30 years ago, Nordnet redefined the financial world as the first digital bank in Europe. Now we're doing it again, building the next generation of cloud-based banking. That takes the right people, the right team, and the right technology.*
 Want to help shape security at Nordnet?
   

  

**We are Nordnet’s security team**
 We are Nordnet's central security function covering information security, IT security, secure development, incident response, and physical security. We believe security is solved together, not in silos, and that every team member brings their own expertise and takes ownership of the team's shared results. We also believe that working as a tight team allows us to have more fun at work!
   

  

 As Information Security Officer, you'll have a broad mandate within information security at Nordnet. This includes:
   

  

* Shape and develop our security posture. Establish and enforce organizational security policies based on strategy, priorities, and legal/regulatory requirements like DORA and CRA.
* Manage third-party risk management end-to-end. Conduct security assessments and build clear security requirements into vendor contracts.
* Build security culture and awareness. Create impactful, engaging awareness programs and communications that make security second nature across the organization.
* Lead security projects. Drive key security initiatives and collaborate cross-functionally to push our goals forward.


 You'll report to the Head of Security. The Security Team includes operational Team Lead roles, and for the right person this could be a natural next step down the line, though it's not a requirement to apply now. If you're up for it, there's also an option to join our on-call rotation, covering a couple of weeks during the year as first responder for security incidents.
   

  

**About You**
 You bring solid experience in information security, frameworks like ISO 27001 and NIST CSF 2.0 are second nature, and ideally you've also worked with DORA in practice, and potentially have started to work with CRA. Five or more years in the field is our starting point; a background in financial services and a technical foundation are a strong plus, since we're a digital bank.
   

  

 You're as comfortable creating engaging security communications as you are digging into the fine print of a regulation. You can independently structure and drive your own area of responsibility, and you have the ability to talk security risk with both the leadership team and the engineers, pitched right for each audience.
   

  

 You take a pragmatic approach to risk: the goal is an adequate level of security relative to the threat, not eliminating every conceivable risk. You know that good security work is built on collaboration and compromise, not solo effort.
   

  

 You're fluent in written and spoken English. Swedish isn't required, but it's a plus.
   

  

**About Us**
 We're building a world-class customer experience with the ambition to become the first choice for savings and investments across the Nordics. You'll join a tight-knit, driven team with a fast pace and real room to make an impact, part of an organization of 900+ employees across Stockholm, Oslo, Helsinki and Copenhagen.
   

  

 We apply individual salary settings. The role is full time employment with a hybrid workplace based in Stockholm.
   

  

 Learn more about us at www.nordnetab.com
   

  

**Questions & applications**
 Questions about the role? Contact Talent Acquisition Partner Lovisa Malmberg, lovisa.malmberg@nordnet.se, +46 73-699 05 07.
   

  

 We only accept applications through our recruitment system, applications by email will not be considered. Nordnet conducts credit and background checks as well as a drug test on the final candidate.

title: Lösningsarkitekt ServiceNow
description:
**Jobbeskrivning**
**Om Sopra Steria:**
 Sopra Steria är Europas ledande konsultföretag inom ServiceNow och digital transformation. Vi hjälper företag och organisationer att effektivisera sina verksamheter genom innovativa teknologilösningar. Med fler än 4000 ServiceNow-experter besitter vi marknadens största och mest framstående ServiceNow-team där får du möjligheten att arbeta med dem mest spännande projekten samt utvecklas i en dynamisk och framåtlutad arbetsmiljö. Nu tar vi nästa stora kliv och satsar ännu hårdare på vår ledande position inom ServiceNow. Hos oss får du chansen att vara med och driva utvecklingen framåt, forma framtidens lösningar och göra verklig skillnad. Vill du vara en del av vårt ledande team?
   

  

**Om rollen:**
 I rollen som lösningsarkitekt inom ServiceNow kommer du vara en central del i utvecklingen och designen av moderna lösningar för att effektivisera arbetsflöden och processer. Som Elite Partner för ServiceNow har vi en av Skandinaviens största och mest kvalificerade konsultgrupper med närmare 500 dedikerade experter. Vi söker nu en senior profil som kan ta en ledande roll i våra teamleveranser tillsammans med våra experter som utvecklar innovativa lösningar för våra kunder.
   

  

**Dina huvudsakliga uppgifter:**
* Designa och implementering avancerade lösningar inom ServiceNow.
* Ledande roll i att utveckla och konfigurera plattformen för att möta specifika krav och behov.
* Arbeta nära affärsavdelningar för att förstå och översätta deras verksamhetsbehov till tekniska lösningar.
* Driva tekniska workshops och rådgivning gentemot kunder.
* Aktiv deltagande i agila team och förmåga att leda och inspirera.


**För att vara framgångsrik i rollen tror vi att du har:**
* Flerårig erfarenhet som arkitekt inom ServiceNow med uppsättning, implementering, utveckling och konfiguration inom plattformen.
* Expertis inom Javascript, HTML, SQL och ITIL.
* Vana av att arbeta i agila team.
* Relevanta certifieringar inom ServiceNow.
* Eftergymnasial utbildning.
* Flytande i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.


**Vi erbjuder:**
* En spännande arbetsmiljö hos Europas ledande ServiceNow-konsultbolag.
* Möjlighet att arbeta med innovativa lösningar och den senaste tekniken.
* Kompetensutveckling genom certifieringar, utbildningar och mentorskap.
* Hybrid arbetsmodell samt konkurrenskraftiga villkor och förmåner


**Om ServiceNow-teamet på Sopra Steria:**
 Sopra Steria är Nordens ledande expert inom ServiceNow – vi har den största och mest specialiserade kompetensen på marknaden. Vårt starka och sammansvetsade team levererar omfattande och högkvalitativa lösningar, där flera av våra erfarna ServiceNow-konsulter samarbetar för att maximera värdet för våra kunder. Vi drivs av innovation, samarbete och kunskapsutbyte – tillsammans sätter vi nya standarder och skapar framtidens digitala lösningar. Vill du arbeta med de bästa? Då är Sopra Steria platsen för dig.
   

  

**Om Sopra Steria:**
 Sopra Steria är en av Europas ledande aktörer inom digital transformation, med över 60 000 medarbetare i mer än 30 länder globalt. Vi driver innovation och hjälper företag och organisationer att effektivisera, utvecklas och skapa långsiktigt värde genom banbrytande teknologilösningar.
   

  

 Hos oss arbetar de främsta experterna inom sina områden i en dynamisk och framtidsorienterad miljö där samarbete, nytänkande och teknisk spetskompetens står i centrum.
   

  

**Ansökan:**
 Om du är redo att ta nästa steg i din karriär och vara en del av en framstående arbetsplats, ansök genom att ladda upp ditt CV. Kontakta gärna ansvarig rekryterare, Teodor Nellvik (teodor.nellvik@soprasteria.com) eller Business Owner Mikael Kroglund (mikael.kroglund@soprasteria.com) för eventuella frågor om tjänsten.
   

  

 På Sopra Steria ställer vi höga krav på både kompetens och säkerhetsmedvetenhet hos våra medarbetare. Innan en eventuell anställning kommer du därför att genomgå en bakgrundskontroll, och vid intervju behöver du kunna uppvisa giltig legitimation.
   

  

**Välkommen till Sopra Steria - där din kompetens formar framtidens digitala lösningar!**

title: 2nd line supporttekniker – se hit!
description:
Eccera söker nu erfarna supporttekniker inom 2nd line till flera av våra kunder i Stockholmsområdet. Är du redo att ta nästa steg i din karriär och arbeta i en mer avancerad supportroll där du får utveckla din tekniska kompetens? Då vill vi gärna komma i kontakt med dig!
 



  





 Som konsult på Eccera får du en trygg anställning och samlar på dig värdefull arbetslivserfarenhet på uppdrag hos våra kunder. Din konsultchef stöttar dig i din utveckling där du hela tiden fyller på med nya erfarenheter och kunskaper. En utmärkt möjlighet att göra karriär.
 



  





**Dina arbetsuppgifter** 




 I rollen som 2nd line supporttekniker arbetar du med mer avancerad felsökning och problemlösning i nära samarbete med både användare och IT-organisationen. Du tar emot ärenden som eskalerats från 1st line och säkerställer att de löses effektivt och med hög kvalitet.
 



  





*Arbetsuppgifter kan bland annat innefatta:* 



* Felsökning och hantering av mer komplexa IT-ärenden inom hårdvara, mjukvara och nätverk
* Arbete i ärendehanteringssystem enligt etablerade processer (t.ex. ITIL)
* Administration i Active Directory (konton, behörigheter, grupper)
* Hantering och felsökning i Microsoft 365 och Azuremiljöer
* Stöd inom klienthantering, exempelvis via Intune
* Nätverksrelaterad felsökning
* Samverkan med 3rd line och andra tekniska team



  





**Din profil** 




 Vi söker dig som trivs i en roll med stort eget ansvar och som motiveras av att lösa mer avancerade tekniska problem. Du är strukturerad i ditt arbetssätt och van att prioritera mellan olika ärenden.
 



  





*Som person är du:* 



* Serviceinriktad och lösningsfokuserad
* Strukturerad och noggrann
* Kommunikativ och pedagogisk i din kontakt med användare
* Självständig men också en lagspelare



  





*Krav* 



* Erfarenhet av att arbeta i en 2nd line supportfunktion
* God erfarenhet av felsökning inom IT-miljöer
* Erfarenhet av Active Directory
* Kunskap inom Microsoft Azure samt Intune
* Erfarenhet av nätverksfelsökning
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska
* Förståelse för ITIL-processer (ITIL Foundation är meriterande)
* Erfarenhet av att dokumentera arbetssätt och skapa kunskapsartiklar



  





*Meriterande* 



* Erfarenhet av Microsoft 365-miljöer
* Erfarenhet av SCCM eller liknande verktyg
* Erfarenhet av scripting eller automation
* Certifieringar inom Microsoft eller ITIL



  





**Vad vi erbjuder** 




 På Eccera får du de verktyg du behöver för att nå dina mål. Vi erbjuder alla våra konsulter kvalificerade utbildningar och certifieringar inom den senaste tekniken. Vi sätter stort värde på att våra medarbetare hela tiden ska fortsätta att utvecklas. Därför erbjuder vi dig möjligheten att lägga upp en individuell utbildningsplan, där vi bekostar såväl studiematerial som själva certifieringarna. Under din utveckling kommer vi matcha din kompetens mot rätt uppdrag i takt med att du avancerar.

title: SAP Project Manager
description:
Are you ready for the next step in your SAP career? Do you want to work in a flexible environment with exciting assignments. We are now looking for an SAP Project Manager who wants to help shape the solutions of the future. Welcome to CGI!
   

  

 Your future duties and responsibilities
   

  

 As an SAP Project Manager, you will play a key role in our deliveries to clients across various industries such as Retail, Manufacturing, and Distribution. Your responsibilities will include:
   

  

* Lead end-to-end SAP roll-in projects across business units, countries, or regions
* Manage project scope, timelines, budget, risks, and dependencies
* Coordinate with global template teams, local business teams, and implementation partners
* Ensure alignment with SAP program governance and deployment methodology
* Drive project status reporting, steering committee updates, and executive communication


**Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role**
* 5+ years of experience in SAP project/program management
* Proven experience managing SAP roll-in or global deployment projects
* Strong expertise in:
* Business Change Management (BCM)
* Organizational Change Management (OCM)
* User Adoption & Training Strategies
* Hands-on experience with WalkMe or other Digital Adoption Platforms
* Experience with cutover strategy and planning
* Strong understanding of SAP business processes (S/4HANA preferred)
* Experience in Agile, Hybrid, or Waterfall delivery methodologies
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
* Fluency in Swedish and English, both spoken and written.


 You are great at building strong relationships and quickly understanding new situations. You enjoy working with others, are attentive and supportive, and like to challenge yourself. With both an analytical mindset and creative problem-solving skills, you handle complex tasks with precision and confidence.
   

  

**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**
 Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…
   

  

 You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.
   

  

 Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.
   

  

 You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.
   

  

 That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.
   

  

 Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

title: Fullstack AI Engineer
description:
At Viaplay Group, we entertain millions of people every day through our streaming services, radio networks, and TV channels. We believe in the power of content not just as a way of telling stories and touching lives, but also expanding worlds.


We’re looking for the best people to join us on our journey. Right now, we’re searching for a **Fullstack AI Engineer** in our **Stockholm** office – are you ready to hit play on an exciting career change?


### **The Role**


You’ll join a small, multidisciplinary team building products that create value for our users and business. Working closely with product, design and engineering colleagues, you’ll turn agreed opportunities into working products and validate them with users.


AI will be a core part of how you build and deliver from development through testing and validation. You’ll help improve these ways of working and share what works with the wider organisation.


You’ll bring hands-on experience across frontend and backend development, with deeper expertise in one or both. You’ll build the services and experiences needed to deliver complete products, contributing beyond your main specialism and taking responsibility for how the software performs in production.


The team starts with a lab approach: focused scope, short feedback loops, and room to experiment. As we learn what works, the aim is to evolve into an established structure with ongoing product responsibilities. You’ll help shape that journey and take care of the products as they develop.


**What your day might look like:**


* Turn agreed product scope into working products and testable releases
* Design, build, and maintain backend services, APIs, and integrations
* Build frontend experiences that connect those services to users
* Apply and improve advanced AI-assisted workflows across development, testing, and validation
* Integrate AI capabilities where they add value to the product
* Work with product and design to use data, user insights, and hypotheses to guide implementation and validate outcomes
* Improve performance, reliability, and maintainability as products develop
* Contribute to deployment, maintenance, and operation, taking responsibility for the software you deliver

### **What we’re looking for**


You’ve used AI across substantial parts of product delivery, beyond individual coding suggestions. You can explain your contribution, how you verified the result, and what you learned.

title: Software Responsible
description:
**Assignment Description**


Help us power sustainable mobility.


Aurobay is looking for a Software Responsible within Software & Electronics group. This is a fantastic opportunity to work with new powertrain control development. You will work as part of a top-performance in-house team with highly skilled people, to create world-class powertrain solutions. Our scope is from hybrid engine control systems to cover fully electric powertrains with functions such as Electrical drive units and inverters.


We are looking for a development engineer who is responsible for understanding customers requirement, find efficient solutions together with our suppliers and co-workers in Aurobay and design solutions. You will get engineering tasks that challenge you to continue your technical and personal development with us. You will be responsible for either one of our ECU´s or inverter in one or more of our ongoing exciting projects.


There are unlimited possibilities at Aurobay for collaborative people who are ready to make the difference. We are re-imagining motion for a brighter future. Exploring how to push our environmental impact towards zero. Designing tomorrow´s powertrain solutions for automotive and beyond.


We’re known for being caring, collaborative people with a global mindset, a passion for innovation and a drive to create excellence. Do you want to join us on our journey?

**What will you do?**


As a Software Responsible, you are the component owner of the software in your project. This means that you lead the deliverables towards the supplier and the customer. You will lead and coordinate the development of the Base Software in the ECU´s or inverters in different phases of the project. You will be part of a team consisting of Software and Hardware engineers led by a GPL (Group Project Leader) and work tightly with the Basetech Architects in our group.


You will be the single point of contact towards the supplier for the product you have responsibility for and need to secure the technology, cost, and timing to meet the project targets. You need to have technical insight in the requirements of the area you work in order to be able to distribute to function owners and plan for implementation according to the spec.

**Skill requirements**

**You have a M.Sc. or B.Sc. in Electrical or Mechatronics Engineering or similar relevant experience.**

**You have experience in Base Software development of one or more of our products; ECM, inverters, TCM, etc. It’s also valuable having knowledge of Autosar, application Software and integration.**


The cross-functional nature of the role offers you possibility to advance your competence in the subsystem areas and your professional network. You need to master communication in English; both in written and spoken. For good collaboration and communication its also desired to have good knowledges in Swedish language.


To flourish at Aurobay you are a caring, collaborative person with a global mindset, and a passion for innovation and a drive to create excellence.


We encourage diversity and believe that the different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives our people bring make us stronger as a company.

title: Senior Build & Infrastructure Engineer [Snowdrop]
description:
Company Description Massive Entertainment is a world-renowned AAA game development studio with offices in Malmö and Stockholm, and a proud part of the Ubisoft family. Our diverse and talented team of around 600 professionals hails from more than 50 countries, all driven by a shared passion for crafting memorable gaming experiences. At Massive, we are committed to pushing the boundaries of creativity and technology, currently leading projects such as Tom Clancy’s The Division 3, Tom Clancy’s The Division 2 and Tom Clancy’s The Division 2: Survivors. We're also at the forefront of tech innovation, developing our proprietary Snowdrop engine, which powers many of Ubisoft’s flagship titles, and contributing to Ubisoft Connect, Ubisoft's digital ecosystem and distribution platform.
  
  

Join us, and you'll have the opportunity to do what you love while shaping the future of interactive entertainment. Job Description Snowdrop is a powerful game engine that enables Ubisoft content creators to set their creative minds free. Fast and flexible, Snowdrop gives developers innovative tools designed from the ground up for creating the unknown. Snowdrop provides the perfect canvas for game developers to paint the games of the future.
  
  

We are currently looking for two new excited and motivated members to join our Build and Infrastructure Team. As a Build & Infrastructure Engineer at Massive, your main responsibility is to develop and maintain the Snowdrop Build System, our internal tools suite for continuous delivery and integration across game projects. You will be a key figure in enabling game productions all over the world to both leverage existing technology and share their own developments as effortlessly as possible. As part of the team, you will also help create and maintain large game build pipelines (orchestrations) for past, present, and future AAA game projects for Ubisoft.
  
  

We are looking for someone who doesn’t like doing the same thing over and over again – who’d rather have the machines working for you than the other way around! You can encourage innovation from concept through to deployment and you appreciate adopting and leveraging new technologies. You are curious, helpful and have a solution-oriented mindset What you’ll do Staying up to date with best practices and industry standards and make sure we apply them in our development processes and in the implementation of our infrastructure Solve interesting, challenging, and sometimes frustrating software problems using all the tools at your disposal Liaising with and assisting other teams on a regular basis regarding use cases, shared issues and questions Generously sharing your know-how and providing support for other team members during critical stages of development Being aware of and planning in accordance with real world constraints Evaluating and integrating new technologies to improve our environment and processes What you’ll get A fun, creative, and passionate workplace. Here you will get to work in a constantly evolving environment with a range of new technologies and it will be your responsibility to provide requirements and use-cases to developers working with Continuous Integration.
  
  

We aim to build a team that continuously pushes the boundaries of what’s possible in game development, and because we love to learn and grow from the people around us, we might ask you to complete a practical test as a part of the recruitment process. Qualifications What you’ll bring To succeed in this position, we see that you have a firm general technical understanding to feel right at home working with systems that see constant change and improvements. We believe you are observant, understanding, and capable of communicating possibilities and threats clearly whilst bringing development forward. Besides the above we’re looking for someone aligned with our core values and the following skills and experience: Experienced back-end developer Professional Python experience Version control systems and CI/CD pipelines (Perforce or gitlab) Service deployments using tools like Docker, Kubernetes and Salt Monitoring and alerting using ELK, Grafana, Prometheus or others Additional information Ubisoft is a global leader in gaming with teams across the world creating original and memorable gaming experiences, from Assassin’s Creed, Rainbow Six to Just Dance and more.
  
  

We believe diverse perspectives help both players and teams thrive. If you’re passionate about innovation and pushing entertainment boundaries, join our journey and help us create the unknown! You can also find a summary of the Massive Job Perks here. All your application information will be kept confidential according to EEO & GDPR guidelines.
